Job description

QUEM SOMOS?

Prazer, somos a Suzano! Aqui a gente acredita que inovação e sustentabilidade caminham juntas. Dessa união, nasce uma atitude plena de significado: a inovabilidade. Pautados por ela, pensamos fora da caixa e enxergamos longe para lidar com os desafios do século 21. Nós plantamos e cultivamos árvores para transformar essa matéria-prima renovável em Bioprodutos para o dia a dia de mais de 2 bilhões de pessoas.

PLURAL

Iguais e diferentes. Singulares e plurais. Acreditamos que a diversidade nos fortalece, por isso, não fazemos distinção entre candidatos seja por deficiência, gênero, orientação sexual, raça/etnia, idade, origem, constituição familiar ou estética.

Main responsibilities

DADOS:

GS 17

Local: Norte

O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER?

  • Responder pela Ex-Mill, Margem de Contribuição, Volume, Faturamento, Distribuição Numérica e Ponderada - dentre outros indicadores de sua região, assegurando o cumprimento das metas estabelecidas pela companhia;
  • Atuar de acordo com a Rotina de Trabalho Suzano estabelecida para os clientes/canais de atendimento Direto ou Indireto;
  • Garantir a execução SUZANO no PDV (Loja Perfeita) - Mix Mínimo, Planograma, Precificação, Qualidade, Exposição e presença de Material de PDV;
  • Presença no Mercado (área sob sua responsabilidade) de acordo com a definição do Processo de Vendas;
  • Aplicar a política comercial Suzano de acordo com a estratégia para a região, canal ou cliente sob sua responsabilidade;
  • Garantir a melhoria contínua do resultado de seus clientes;
  • Estabelecer Planos de Negócios – JBP, para as contas/clientes sob sua responsabilidade;
  • Gerenciar contas e clientes sob sua responsabilidade;
  • Realizar o planejamento colaborativo de Demanda de produtos;
  • Prospectar clientes com potencial e que estejam dentro do perfil de produtos SUZANO;
  • Explorar detalhadamente cada ponto da sua verba off-invoice;
  • Atuar e monitorar o Sell Out nos seus clientes;
  • Avaliar seu próprio desempenho e propor-se um plano de melhoria operacional continuamente;
  • Ter domínio sobre condições comerciais expressas nos contratos realizados com os clientes de sua carteira.

Requirements and skills

QUEM NOS INSPIRA?

  • Alguém que acredite em nossos valores;
  • Com iniciativa;
  • Perfil analítico;
  • Que proponha ideias e soluções.

O QUE A SUZANO ESPERA DE VOCÊ?

  • Ensino Superior Completo;
  • Disponibilidade de viagens;
  • Desejável conhecimento em: Pacote Office; Matemática Financeira; Alavancas Comerciais; Técnicas de Negociação;
  • Conhecer do mercado e clientes de bens de consumo do mercado/da região;
  • Ter conhecimento dos clientes e varejistas da região de atuação;
  • Ser dinâmico, comunicativo, negociador, proativo, resiliente e com foco em resultados.

Additional information

NÓS TEMOS MUITO MAIS QUE UM PAPEL NA SUA VIDA!

Cuidados da sua saúde: Plano Médico, Odonto e Seguro de Vida;

VR ou Refeitório, VA para ajudar nas compras do mercado;

Sabemos que a renda fixa é importante, mas, além disso, oferecemos uma renda extra por meio do nosso Programa de Remuneração Variável (Anual);

Para você se preparar para o futuro temos a Previdência privada;

Praticamos o home office em áreas corporativas, a flexibilidade de horários, além do dress code casual;

Para gerar e compartilhar valor disponibilizamos cursos e treinamentos E-learning em nossa plataforma digital, o UniverSuzano;

Na Suzano, só é bom para nós se for bom para o mundo! Por isso, durante o ano realizamos muitas ações legais e você poderá se tornar um voluntário do nosso programa Voluntariar;

Também contamos com um Clube de Descontos, com diversos parceiros, para você aproveitar!

PARA A FAMÍLIA

Como empresa cidadã, entendemos a importância da chegada de uma criança. Por isso, oferecemos extensão da licença paternidade para 20 dias e maternidade para 180 dias. O benefício também vale para papais e mamães que adotarem ou obtiverem a guarda judicial da criança;

Sobre nós
A Evolucional acredita que o uso de dados pode transformar a educação e o processo de aprendizagem. Atuamos, desde 2014, oferecendo simulados e avaliações para escolas em todo o Brasil. Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Experiência sólida em ReactJS e/ou Angular, com projetos entregues em produção.

Diferenciais (Desejáveis)

  • TypeScript : tipagem estática, generics e uso em projetos complexos.

  • Conhecimento de metodologias ágeis, CI/CD e pipelines de automação (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, etc.).
  • Experiência com frameworks de design system (Storybook, Bit) ou bibliotecas de UI.

Competências Comportamentais Necessárias

  • Proatividade e senso de dono
  • – Antecipar desafios, sugerir melhorias e assumir responsabilidade pelos resultados.
  • Comunicação clara e empática
  • – Transmitir ideias de forma objetiva, ouvir ativamente e dar/receber feedback construtivo.
  • Colaboração e trabalho em equipe
  • – Compartilhar conhecimento, apoiar colegas em bloqueios e alinhar-se com diferentes áreas (design, back-end, QA).
  • Orientação a resultados
  • – Manter o foco em metas e prazos, equilibrando qualidade de código e entregas ágeis.
  • Adaptabilidade e flexibilidade
  • – Ajustar-se rapidamente a mudanças de requisitos, novas tecnologias e prioridades de negócio.
  • Organização e gestão do tempo
  • – Priorizar tarefas, estimar prazos de forma realista e garantir entregas dentro do planejado.
  • Curiosidade e aprendizado contínuo
  • – Buscar ativamente novas ferramentas, frameworks e boas práticas para evoluir o produto e o próprio conhecimento.
  • Resiliência e gestão de pressão
  • – Manter a calma sob prazos apertados, lidar bem com retrabalho e aprender com erros.
  • Empatia com o usuário final
  • – Colocar-se no lugar de quem utiliza a aplicação, garantindo usabilidade, acessibilidade e boa experiência.

title: Analyst, Infrastructure
description:
GIC is one of the world’s largest sovereign wealth funds. With over 2,000 employees across 11 offices around the world, we invest in more than 40 countries globally across asset classes and businesses. Working at GIC gives you exposure to an extraordinary network of the world’s industry leaders. As a leading global long-term investor, we Work at the Point of Impact for Singapore’s financial future, and the communities we invest in worldwide.
Infrastructure
We deploy long-term capital through direct, and fund investments across the capital structure to diversify our portfolio. You will help to preserve and enhance the value of our direct private and public equity investments, working with top management teams and board of directors.

The Sao Paulo team was established in 2015, and currently has nine investment professionals. The team is focused on analyzing opportunities in South and Central America, as well as managing the investments made since 2013 in the region. It is integrated into the global team which operates from London, New York, Singapore and Sao Paulo.

Illustrative investments include Aegea (water and sanitation in Brazil), CART/Eixo SP (toll roads in Brazil), V.tal (fiber optics in Brazil), Neoenergia Transmission (power transmission in Brazil), NTS (gas pipeline in Brazil) and Isagen (power generation in Colombia), amongst others. GIC Infrastructure approaches investments with a buy and hold perspective and manages assets with a long-term perspective. We focus on minority / co-control investments alongside industrial and financial partners and have consolidated ourselves as one of the most active investors in the sector and region.

We are looking for a suitable candidate to join our Sao Paulo team as an Analyst. GIC desires to become the leading long term global infrastructure investor and an outstanding career path is available for high performers.
What impact can you make in this role
You will be part of a team that invests into infrastructure companies with stable and predictable cash flows, reasonable risk-adjusted returns and strong impact to local economies.

What you will do as an Analyst
• Play a central role in growing GIC Infrastructure’s portfolio and supporting existing investments in the region.
• Under the supervision of the senior team, play an integral role in the full deal lifecycle: deal screening, approvals, execution, asset management and, when appropriate, exits.
• Take on primary role in the financial modeling of transactions, deal with senior management, external advisors and banks.
• Play a key part in deal screening and appraisal, contributing to transaction analysis, and helping prepare the documentation to support investment decisions to investment committee.
• Investment focus is likely to be biased towards, but not limited to, the power, midstream, transportation, digital infrastructure and water utility sectors. No experience in infrastructure sectors is required, but the candidate will be required to conduct financial research on public and private companies for potential acquisitions.
• The team operates in a flat and meritocratic culture, empowering staff with open communications and robust challenges. Being a team player and interacting with counterparties in a way that builds on our reputation is everyone’s responsibility.
What makes you a successful candidate?
• Bachelor’s degree from a top-tier university with coursework emphasizing business administration, economics, accounting, finance, and/or engineering. Graduation date between June 2024 and June 2025.
• Previous experience working for a private equity fund, institutional investors, or for investment banks as part of the M&A advisory or Equity research team. Experience in the infrastructure sector is not required.
• Outstanding financial modelling skills are assumed and will be tested. The ability to build models from scratch is required, as well as model review and scenario development.
• You will be detail-oriented with a hands-on attitude to deal execution and will thrive in a culture of high-expectations and personal responsibility to own the investment.
• Strong commercial and intellectual curiosity is a requirement to perform well and advance.
Work at the Point of Impact
We need to be forward-looking to attract the right people to help us become the Leading Global Long-Term Investor. Join our ambitious, agile, and diverse teams - be empowered to push boundaries and pursue innovative ideas, share your views, and be heard. Be anchored on our PRIME Values: Prudence, Respect, Integrity, Merit and Excellence, which guides us in how we make our day-to-day decisions. We strive to inspire. To make an impact.
Flexibility at GIC
At GIC, our offices are vibrant hubs for ideation, professional growth, and interpersonal connection. At the same time, we believe that flexibility allows us to do our best work and be our best selves. Thus, our teams come into the office at least four days per week to harness the benefits of in-person collaboration but have the flexibility to choose which days they work from home and adjust this arrangement as situational needs arise.

We are an equal opportunity employer
As an employer, we passionately believe every individual brings with them unique diversity of thought and perspectives to meaningfully enrich perspectives of GIC teams to drive competitive performance. An inclusive environment yields exceptional contribution.

Sobre a vaga

Como Technical Account Manager (TAM), você será a ponte entre nossos clientes e a equipe técnica, garantindo a integração dos dados tanto de entrada quanto de saída. Além disso, será responsável por solucionar desafios técnicos, apoiar na resolução de falhas na integração e garantir uma experiência fluida para o cliente. Se você gosta de tecnologia, tem habilidades analíticas e uma excelente comunicação, essa vaga é para você!

O que você fará no dia-a-dia

  1. Trabalhar diretamente com os clientes garantindo a integração dos dados de entrada e saída e auxiliando os clientes na configuração de acessos, suporte em SQL e validação dos dados antes da integração.
  2. Atuar com diversos ERPs do segmento de varejo a fim de construir, homologar e manter as integrações.
  3. Atuar em conjunto com o time de integração e CSM para garantir que os dados sejam processados corretamente e estejam coerentes com os ERPs.
  4. Monitorar e diagnosticar falhas técnicas na integração, atuando proativamente na solução de problemas.
  5. Comunicar-se de forma clara e eficaz com clientes e times internos, garantindo o alinhamento de expectativas e prazos.
  6. Trabalhar na melhoria contínua dos processos de integração e suporte técnico aos clientes.
  7. Criar e manter as documentações funcionais e técnicas atualizadas no que tange aos processos internos e externos de integração.

Esse é um desafio para quem tem:

  1. SQL intermediário: Capacidade de escrever, revisar e otimizar queries para extração e transformação de dados.
  2. Conhecimento em APIs e automação (desejável): Experiência com consumo de APIs RESTful e scripts para automação de tarefas técnicas.
  3. Boa comunicação: Facilidade para interagir com clientes técnicos e não técnicos, traduzindo necessidades de negócio em soluções técnicas.
  4. Capacidade analítica: Habilidade para identificar e solucionar problemas de inconsistência ou divergência de dados.
  5. Organização e gestão de tarefas: Capacidade de priorizar demandas e gerenciar múltiplos clientes simultaneamente.
  6. Agilidade e poder de persuasão: Capacidade de negociar com os clientes e stakeholders, em defesa das necessidades e desejos dos clientes sem esquecer das necessidades da empresa.

Será legal se você tiver:

  1. Conhecimento no segmento de Varejo.
  2. Ter trabalhado com ERPs.
  3. Experiência com integrações de dados: Conhecimento sobre bancos de dados relacionais e processos ETL.
  4. Conhecimento em ferramentas no code como Zapier, n8n.
  5. Conhecimento em ferramentas de dataviz como Metabase.

O que oferecemos:

  4. Benefícios plataforma Convênia: Descontos em Produtos e Serviços, Lazer, Alimentos e Bebidas, Bem-Estar e Saúde, Educação e outros.

Trabalhamos para que a vida possa avançar e estamos sempre à procura de pessoas inovadoras que possam contribuir com a nossa missão. Que tal fazer parte do nosso time?

Local Principal: Brasil (BR) - São Paulo - Indaiatuba
Função: Technology (CA)
Título: Infrastructure Analyst I - Infrastructure Data Center and End User - Indaiatuba/SP - 113250

Como Analista de Infraestrutura JR em Data Center e usuário final, no Escritório Regional em Indaiatuba/SP, você contribuirá na sustentação, operação e evolução do ambiente de TI da empresa. O profissional será responsável por administrar servidores, redes, soluções de virtualização e ferramentas de monitoramento, garantindo alta disponibilidade, desempenho e segurança da infraestrutura.

Principais Responsabilidades
  • Administrar Windows Server e serviços relacionados, incluindo Active Directory;
  • Gerenciar ambientes Linux, serviços como NFS, CIFS, Web Servers (Apache, Nginx, Wildfly);
  • Operar e manter soluções de IAM (Identity and Access Management) e eIDP (Identity Providers);
  • Monitorar e garantir a observabilidade da infraestrutura com ferramentas como Zabbix, New Relic;
  • Gerenciar soluções de backup corporativo, com foco em Veeam e Data Domain (Dell);
  • Criar, configurar e manter servidores virtuais em ambiente Nutanix HCI;
  • Atuar na administração de redes corporativas, incluindo roteadores de borda, switches, firewalls, links WAN e infraestrutura de telefonia;
  • Apoiar projetos de melhoria contínua e automação de processos de infraestrutura;
  • Documentar procedimentos técnicos e manter registros atualizados de configurações e mudanças.
Habilidades Que Você Precisa
  • Graduação completa ou cursando em Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia da Computação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência comprovada com Windows Server, Active Directory, Linux e serviços de rede;
  • Conhecimento em Servidores Web (Apache, Nginx, Wildfly) e protocolos de compartilhamento de arquivos (NFS, CIFS);
  • Vivência com IAM/IDP e boas práticas de controle de acesso;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade (Zabbix, New Relic);
  • Conhecimento em soluções de backup corporativo, especialmente Data Domain;
  • Experiência de virtualização em Nutanix HCI;
  • Sólido conhecimento em infraestrutura de redes, incluindo roteadores, switches, firewalls, links WAN e telefonia corporativa.
O Que Faz Destacar
  • Certificações como Microsoft (MCSA/MCSE), Linux (LPIC, RHCSA), Nutanix Certified Professional, ITIL, Cisco (CCNA/CCNP);
  • Conhecimento em automação com Ansible, PowerShell ou Bash;
  • Experiência com ambientes em nuvem (AWS, Azure, GCP).

Nossos principais benefícios

  • Remuneração variável;
  • Plano de Saúde;
  • Plano Odontológico;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Previdência Privada;
  • Benefício Ótica;

title: Full Stack .NET Application Developer
description:
We are looking for a highly skilled and motivated professional to join our technology team as a Full Stack .NET Application Developer. In this role, you will play a key part in designing, building, and maintaining robust web applications using the Microsoft .NET ecosystem. If you thrive in collaborative, fast-paced settings and are passionate about creating reliable software solutions from concept to deployment, we invite you to join our growing team.

Please note that this position is currently aligned with a future opportunity. We are in the process of reviewing profiles and engaging in initial conversations to proactively build our pipeline for upcoming roles.

.NET Application Developer – Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, test, and deploy scalable, high-performance web applications using C#, ASP.NET Core, and modern JavaScript frameworks (such as React, Angular, or Vue.js).
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including product managers, UI/UX designers, and other developers, to deliver software aligned with business goals.
  • Implement RESTful APIs and web services to support web and mobile solutions.
  • Work with relational databases, including developing and maintaining SQL Server database models, stored procedures, and queries.
  • Ensure applications are maintainable, secure, and performant by following best practices in software engineering and application security.
  • Participate in peer reviews, architectural discussions, and shared learning to foster a culture of innovation and code quality.
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve application issues across both front-end and back-end layers.
  • Write clear documentation and contribute to internal knowledge bases.
  • Stay current with new technologies and development trends in the .NET and web development ecosystems.

Required Skills and Experience – Full Stack .NET Developer

  • Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience building full stack applications with C# and ASP.NET Core.
  • Proficiency with front-end technologies, including JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3, and experience with front-end frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue.js.
  • In-depth experience creating and consuming RESTful APIs.
  • Strong background in SQL Server, with expertise in writing efficient queries and designing relational data models.
  • Familiarity with version control systems, particularly Git.
  • Basic knowledge of cloud services on Azure or a similar cloud platform.
  • Experience working with Entity Framework Core or other ORMs.
  • Upper intermediate English proficiency, both written and verbal.

Preferred Qualifications – .NET Web Application Development

  • Experience with Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, and containerization tools (Docker).
  • Background with unit testing, integration testing, and automated deployment practices.
  • Understanding of application security best practices and secure coding standards.
  • Knowledge of microservices architecture or domain-driven design (DDD).
  • Hands-on experience with agile methodologies and distributed/remote teams.

title: Manager, Capacity Planning & Network Modeling
description:
Manager, Capacity Planning & Network Modeling

Empresa: Ball Corporation

Further your career at Ball, a world leader in manufacturing sustainable aluminum packaging. Achieve extraordinary things when you join our team, and make a difference in your professional development, the community, and around the globe!

Ball is thrilled to receive Newsweek's 2023 Top 100 Global Most Loved Workplace award! As a sustainable product leader, we have over 16,000 global team members. From endlessly recyclable aluminum cans, and cups, to aerosol bottles, our goal is to contribute to a better community, society, and world.

Position Overview:
Optimize global logistics network efficiency and effectiveness through capacity planning, network modeling, and warehouse engineering. This role analyzes infrastructure, mid- and long-term supply plans, and designs agile, cost-effective networks to accommodate growth while maximizing service levels.

Your Key Responsibilities Include:

  1. Conduct detailed analysis of current logistics capacity, including warehouse space, transportation routes, and distribution centers, to identify optimization opportunities. Project mid- and long-term capacity requirements. Monitor KPIs related to logistics capacity and network performance.
  2. Utilize advanced modeling techniques and simulation tools to translate supply plans into optimal logistics networks, considering transportation costs, lead times, inventory levels, and service requirements. Provide short-term analysis and recommendations for resilient network adaptations in response to unplanned capacity or demand changes.
  3. Design and oversee warehouse layout plans to maximize productivity and throughput volumes.
  4. Establish and maintain global MHE (Material Handling Equipment), including automation standards and requirements.
  5. Collaborate with cross-functional teams—commercial, operations, planning, logistics, and finance—to align capacity planning efforts with business objectives.
  6. Lead projects and coordinate stakeholder resources for capacity expansion initiatives, such as warehouse expansions, fleet upgrades, or network reconfigurations.
  7. Regularly review and audit logistics capacity and network performance to ensure alignment with business needs.
  8. Stay informed about industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in logistics capacity planning, network modeling, and warehouse design.
  9. Provide guidance and support to logistics team members on capacity planning tools, processes, and methodologies.

Required Experience and Skills:

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Supply Chain Management, Statistics, or equivalent experience.
  • Fluent or advanced proficiency in English.
  • Logistics Experience:
    • Experience in logistics operations, including transportation, warehousing, and distribution, with a focus on network optimization strategies.
    • Experience designing and optimizing logistics networks, considering costs, lead times, and service levels.
  • Capacity Planning:
    • Experience in demand forecasting and resource optimization within logistics.
    • Ability to analyze logistics capacity data and identify areas for improvement.
    • Proficiency with modeling and simulation tools for demand forecasting and capacity evaluation.
  • Network Modeling:
    • Experience in designing agile, cost-effective logistics networks using various modeling tools and techniques.
  • Team Collaboration and Interpersonal Skills:
    • Ability to effectively collaborate across departments to align capacity planning with business goals.

Ball Corporation is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We actively encourage applications from everyone. All qualified applicants will receive consideration regardless of race, color, religion, creed, national origin, ethnicity, genetic information, ancestry, marital status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, age, political affiliation, or other non-merit factors.

When you join Ball, you become part of a team of over 16,000 members worldwide. Our products, from recyclable cans and cups to aerosol bottles, help our customers contribute to a better world.

We are committed to diversity and inclusion, fostering a culture of belonging.

Everyone at Ball makes a difference through the work they love. Our creations may change, but our impact remains constant.

Direct message the job poster from Upstream

We are a leader in mobile technology, providing innovative solutions to 1.2 billion consumers. In an ever-increasing digital world, we help businesses grow their digital reach & toolkits to optimize user experience, increase engagement, attract new customers, and boost their revenues.

Think of performance marketing but on steroids as our top-notch marketeers and engineers build digital journeys through an omnichannel marketing approach like no other. Currently, we work with the biggest names in Telco, Insurance, Education, FMCGs, and Retail in over 45 countries in Latin America, Africa, the Middle East, and Southeast Asia.

The role

We are looking for a Performance Marketing Manager to work closely with our teams and drive the performance of our innovative products to optimize the campaigns towards revenue and success. The role will be reporting directly to the Performance Marketing Director.

As a Performance Marketing Manager, you will be responsible for designing, planning, testing, and delivering Marketing campaigns while you will define the strategy of each campaign, deep dive into data, and come up with conclusions and propositions. Your work will ultimately allow Upstream to positively impact millions of consumers around the world.

Key Accountabilities

  • Manage a portfolio of accounts, ensuring that all campaigns are delivered effectively to deadline and against business objectives.
  • Define the strategy of the campaigns and lead the acquisitions process towards campaign efficiency.
  • Design and execute multi-channel campaigns and the acquisition process.
  • Optimization of channels, engagement, and monetization KPIs.
  • Ongoing optimization via segmentation, testing, and user experience improvements.
  • Create reports for accounts, new channels, flows & tests.
  • Provide forecasts, reports, and analyses with conclusions and propositions.
  • Keep detailed documentation and create case studies.
  • Work with the wider internal team towards achieving annual revenue and targets.

The role will be based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.

*Please submit your CV in English.

title: Enfermeiro(a) Auditor - Auditoria Retrospectiva
description:
Horário: De segunda-feira a sexta-feira das 07:40 às 17:28
Modalidade: Presencial
Descrição:

  • Estudar as atualizações do Rol de procedimentos da ANS (Agência Nacional da Saúde), para que possa atuar de forma proativa mediante as coberturas contratuais dos beneficiários.
  • Analisar contas de alto custo de diárias, taxas, materiais de consumo e medicamentos.
  • Analisar os procedimentos com utilização de OPME, avaliando a compatibilidade dos materiais solicitados, conforme protocolos pré-estabelecidos e demais padronizações.
  • Realizar auditoria retrospectiva de contas de pacientes com alta hospitalar, analisando o prontuário médico, verificando materiais e medicamentos referentes ao período de internação, liberando o pagamento da conta hospitalar.
  • Executar a auditoria retrospectiva das Contas Ambulatoriais, Internações Clínicas e Cirúrgicas dos Beneficiários atendidos em Prestadores locais e Intercâmbio Nacional, para análise da quantidade de materiais e medicamentos utilizados.
  • Elaborar relatórios frente aos processos de auditoria retrospectiva, apontando as divergências encontradas, para apoiar as ações estratégicas discutidas nas reuniões de sinistralidade junto a Superintendência.
  • Analisar os processos e responder as contestações de glosa encaminhadas pelos prestadores dentro do prazo determinado.
  • Avaliar a assistência de enfermagem prestada ao cliente através do prontuário médico.
  • Realizar a análise e comparação (depara) de tabelas dos prestadores com as atualizações da TNUMM/TUSS, envolvendo inclusão, exclusão, substituições e fracionamento de itens (Materiais e medicamentos).
  • Realizar a análise de contas da oncologia com protocolos e medicações de alto custo.

Requisitos:

Graduação completa em enfermagem;

Desejável Pós-graduação em Auditoria em saúde;

Conhecimento em Pacote Office;

Coren ativo.

Já pensou como o seu trabalho pode impactar o dia a dia de milhões de brasileiros? Aqui, fazemos isso todos os dias, com uma equipe especial que se dedica às pessoas, valoriza as diferenças e age sempre com respeito e eficiência.

Responsabilidades da Oportunidade
Já pensou como o seu trabalho pode impactar o dia a dia de milhões de brasileiros? Aqui, fazemos isso todos os dias, com uma equipe especial que se dedica às pessoas, valoriza as diferenças e age sempre com respeito e eficiência.
Acreditamos que a diversidade, equidade e inclusão são pilares essenciais na construção de uma cultura inclusiva e para caminharmos nessa direção, contamos com o +Plural, um movimento que nasce do compromisso de evoluir diariamente nossas ações inclusivas e avançar cada vez mais na representatividade de nossas pessoas nos cinco grupos prioritários: Pessoas com deficiência, Pessoas Negras (pretas e pardas), Mulheres (Cis e Trans), LGBTQIA+ e Geração Sênior (50+).
Está claro que só falta uma coisa para completar esse time: VOCÊ ! Que tal ser protagonista dessa história junto com a gente?
Além de ser nosso cliente, você agora tem a chance de fazer parte do nosso time!
Quais serão seus desafios?

  • Liderar o relacionamento com o parceiro de call center, assegurando a qualidade e a eficiência do atendimento nos canais digitais.
  • Coordenar a definição, implementação e evolução de fluxos do bot conversacional (WhatsApp), acompanhando seu desempenho e propondo ajustes.
  • Atuar de forma colaborativa com as áreas de tecnologia, atendimento, marketing e produto, garantindo uma jornada do cliente integrada e consistente.
  • Monitorar indicadores de performance do canal conversacional, realizando análises e propondo ações de melhoria contínua.
  • Assegurar que os fluxos automatizados estejam em conformidade com as políticas de privacidade, segurança da informação e compliance.
  • Identificar e propor oportunidades de automação e personalização do atendimento digital, visando maior eficiência e experiência do cliente.
O que consideramos importante para que você faça parte do nosso time?
  • Formação superior completa em Marketing, Administração, Comunicação, Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Vivência anterior na gestão de canais de atendimento digital e/ou bots conversacionais.
  • Conhecimento em plataformas de automação de atendimento, como Blip, SmartNX ou similares.
  • Experiência na gestão de parceiros e fornecedores.
  • Perfil analítico, com foco em resultados e na melhoria contínua de processos.
  • Conhecimento desejável em UX Writing e jornada do cliente.
  • Experiência com projetos de commerce conversacional em grandes operações de e-commerce ou varejo (Desejável).
  • Conhecimento em integrações com CRM e plataformas de e-commerce (Desejável).

title: Consultor de RH
description:
Vaga: Consultora de RH

ATENÇÃO, CANDIDATA: Gentileza ler com atenção a descrição completa da vaga e se cadastrar apenas se cumprir com os requisitos obrigatórios.

Descrição geral da vaga:

Estamos buscando uma Consultora de RH para o nosso time: Somos uma consultoria com raízes em Belo Horizonte e atuação em todo o Brasil. Nossa equipe é composta por Consultores Associados, especializados em projetos que vão desde a Implantação da área de RH “do zero” até Transformação Cultural, Desenvolvimento de Liderança, Recrutamento e Seleção, entre outros serviços estratégicos focados em Recursos Humanos.

O grande desafio desta posição é atuar liderando projetos e processos de alta complexidade em diversas frentes do RH. A posição envolve a implantação, gestão, execução e acompanhamento de iniciativas robustas nas áreas que envolvem a jornada de experiências do colaborador, tais como cargos e salários, remuneração variável, gestão do clima, gestão do desempenho, trilha de carreira, treinamento e desenvolvimento, recrutamento & seleção e comunicação interna. Será responsável por desenvolver soluções integradas e inovadoras, contribuindo diretamente para o fortalecimento da cultura organizacional e promovendo uma experiência positiva para os colaboradores.

Descrição das atividades:

  1. Implantação da área de RH seguindo as metodologias da consultoria.
  2. Atuar no desenvolvimento, execução e gerenciamento de projetos.
  3. Liderar projetos, administrando custos, escopos e prazos, assegurando o atendimento aos objetivos estratégicos da área.
  4. Colaborar com stakeholders internos e externos, incluindo departamentos jurídicos de governança e compliance.
  5. Gerenciar o plano de cargos e salários, analisando promoções, enquadramentos e programas de benefícios.
  6. Desenvolver relatórios gerenciais para suporte à tomada de decisão.
  7. Implantar e administrar programas de avaliação de desempenho, planejamento de carreira e PDI.
  8. Apoiar os líderes nas rotinas e processos de gestão.

Requisitos Obrigatórios:

  1. Ensino superior completo em RH, Administração, Psicologia ou áreas afins;
  2. Pacote Office intermediário;
  3. Habilidade para conduzir reuniões e articulação com diferentes públicos;
  4. Experiência em áreas generalistas de RH, desenvolvimento de pessoas e gestão de projetos;
  5. Experiência com alta e média liderança.

Requisitos desejáveis:

  1. Pacote Office avançado;
  2. Pós-graduação/MBA em Recursos Humanos, Gestão de Pessoas, Gestão da Mudança, Desenvolvimento de Líderes;
  3. Formação em BP e Coaching Executivo.

Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer

Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer

1 day ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring a Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer to our Information Systems (IS) team. This role is an opportunity for an "automation-first" senior technologist with a passion for Linux to build a career with Canonical and drive the success with those leveraging Ubuntu and open source products. If you have experience of IT operations automation, Infrastructure as Code and a passion for technology, then you will enjoy working with some of the best people in the industry at Canonical.
Job Summary
The IS team at Canonical supports and maintains all of Canonical's IT production services. The team is in charge of running services used by over 60 million Ubuntu users.
As an Senior SRE & Gitops engineer you'll be in a unique position to drive operations automation to the next level, both in our own private clouds as well as in the public clouds. We do this by utilizing the best of open source infrastructure as code software, software development practices such as CI/CD pipelines, and Canonical's leading products for software operation automation.
In addition to defining the infrastructure as code, you will improve Canonical products and the open-source technologies they're based on by providing critical feedback to developers on how their products operate at scale. This is done by submitting bugs (and sometimes writing pull requests) and collaborating on design and implementations with other teams within the company.
You'll be part of a global team of SREs that work together and support each other to provide the best possible services to our company, Canonical's customers and the Ubuntu Community.
As a Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer you will

  • Drive the development of automation, Gitops in your team as an embedded tech lead
  • Closely collaborate with the IS architect to align your solutions with the IS architecture vision
  • Design and architect services that IS can offer to the organization as products
  • Apply your experience of IaC to develop infrastructure as code practice within IS by constantly increasing automation and improving IaC processes
  • Automate software operations for re-usability and consistency across private and public clouds, taking into consideration the complexities of distributed systems
  • Maintain operational responsibility for all of Canonical's core services, networks, and infrastructure
  • Develop skills in troubleshooting, capacity planning, and performance investigation, Setting up, maintaining and using observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, and Elasticsearch; design, implement and maintain monitoring and alerting for various systems and services
  • Provide assistance and work with globally distributed engineering, operations, and support peers
  • Be given uninterrupted development time to focus on larger projects and automation of manual tasks
  • Share your experience, know-how and best practices with other team members in design sessions, mentorship and 'doing work together'
  • Carry final responsibility for time-critical escalations
What we are looking for in you
  • A modern view on hosting architecture, driven by infrastructure as code across both private and public clouds.
  • A product mindset thriving to develop products rather than solutions.
  • Python software development experience, with large projects
  • Experience working with Kubernetes or other container orchestration systems.
  • Proven exposure to manage and deploy cloud infrastructure with code.
  • Practical knowledge of Linux networking, routing, and firewalls
  • Affinity with various forms of Linux storage, from Ceph to Databases
  • Hands-on experience administering enterprise Linux servers
  • Extensive knowledge of cloud computing concepts and technologies
  • Bachelor's degree or greater, preferably in computer science or related engineering field
  • Able to communicate clearly and effectively in English over email, chat, video or voice calls and in-person
  • Motivated and able to troubleshoot from kernel to web, and willing to ask others when appropriate
  • A willingness to be flexible and able to learn new things quickly
  • Be inspired by the needs of fast-changing environments
  • Happy to work within distributed teams
  • Be passionate and familiarized about open-source, especially Ubuntu or Debian
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

• Organização para lidar com prazos e múltiplos projetos simultaneamente.

Desejável:

Na Serasa Experian, acreditamos que a diversidade é fundamental para um ambiente de trabalho mais saudável e inovador, onde todas as pessoas possam trocar experiências e expressar suas ideias. description:
Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer

Join to apply for the Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer role at Canonical .

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include top public cloud and silicon providers, as well as industry leaders across sectors. We are a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and few office-based roles, meeting in person 2-4 times yearly in interesting locations worldwide.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring a Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer for our Information Systems (IS) team. This role is ideal for an automation-first senior technologist passionate about Linux, aiming to build a career with Canonical and support those leveraging Ubuntu and open source products. If you have experience in IT operations automation, Infrastructure as Code, and a passion for technology, you'll thrive here.

Job Summary

The IS team supports and maintains all of Canonical's IT production services, serving over 60 million Ubuntu users. As a Senior SRE & Gitops Engineer, you'll drive operations automation in our private and public clouds using open source infrastructure as code tools, CI/CD pipelines, and Canonical's automation products. You will also provide feedback to developers to improve product operation at scale, contribute to open source projects, and collaborate across teams.

Responsibilities

  • Lead automation and Gitops initiatives as a technical lead within your team.
  • Align solutions with the IS architecture vision by collaborating with the IS architect.
  • Design and develop services to be offered as products by IS.
  • Advance infrastructure as code practices, increasing automation and process improvements.
  • Automate software operations across clouds, considering distributed system complexities.
  • Maintain operational responsibility for core services, networks, and infrastructure.
  • Enhance troubleshooting, capacity planning, and performance monitoring using tools like Prometheus, Grafana, and Elasticsearch.
  • Support and collaborate with global engineering, operations, and support teams.
  • Focus on larger projects and automation during dedicated development time.
  • Share expertise through design sessions, mentorship, and collaborative work.
  • Handle time-critical escalations responsibly.

Qualifications

  • Experience with hosting architecture driven by infrastructure as code across private and public clouds.
  • Product mindset focused on developing products rather than just solutions.
  • Proficiency in Python, especially with large projects.
  • Experience with Kubernetes or similar container orchestration systems.
  • Proven ability to manage and deploy cloud infrastructure with code.
  • Practical knowledge of Linux networking, routing, and firewalls.
  • Familiarity with Linux storage solutions like Ceph and databases.
  • Hands-on experience administering enterprise Linux servers.
  • Deep understanding of cloud computing concepts and technologies.
  • Bachelor's degree or higher in computer science or related field.
  • Effective communication skills in English via multiple channels.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills from kernel to web, with a collaborative attitude.
  • Willingness to learn quickly and adapt to fast-changing environments.
  • Comfort working within distributed teams.
  • Passion for open source, especially Ubuntu or Debian.

What We Offer

Competitive global compensation, annual reviews, performance bonuses, and benefits aligned with our values. Additional perks include:

  • Distributed work environment with biannual in-person team sprints.
  • USD 2,000 annual learning and development budget.
  • Recognition rewards, annual leave, parental leave, wellness programs, and travel opportunities.

About Canonical

Canonical pioneers open source, publishing Ubuntu, a key platform for AI, IoT, and cloud. We hire globally, uphold high standards, and foster a discrimination-free workplace. Working here challenges you to think differently, learn continually, and excel.

description:
Our Essence:

Patria is, essentially, a long-lasting and resilient entrepreneurial Partnership, that continually assesses the environment and identifies trends. We quickly adapt our investments and product offering to capture investment opportunities derived from such analysis, delivering consistent results to our clients and creating long-lasting impact for all our stakeholders. About Patria:

Patria is made of high performers like you. Behind every result we achieve as a team, there are talented people with unique set of skills: From an entrepreneurial spirit to high a performance mindset. From high-level expertise to a hands-on approach.

It is through these qualities that we have fostered trusting relationships with each of our clients. We proudly highlight our high returns to our investors coupled with our unwavering commitment to ethical values.

That’s why we have been known as the regional and sector specialist in alternative asset management with on-the-ground expertise everywhere we operate. Patria anticipates trends to create long-lasting impact for all our stakeholders for over 35 years. We envision to keep delivering consistent results to better serve our clients.

This position will be based in our Office in Brazil in a full in person work model.

Position Summary:

The digital workplace head is responsible for the strategy and management of digital workplace technologies and services, ensuring a seamless digital employee experience (DEX). This role covers all functions of the digital workplace, including the service desk management, budgeting, and IT asset management (hardware and software), enhancing digital dexterity, and driving positive business outcomes, while maintaining compliance with SOX and ITGC controls.

Main responsibilities:

  • Reporting to Infrastructure Head and partner with the CIO/CTO, human resources, facilities and other IT and business leaders to set the strategic direction of the digital workplace and DEX improvements.
  • Lead the digital workplace operations team focused on fulfilling (telephony included) end-user support and service requests, including the IT service desk, the VIP and desktop support, A/V support, Active Directory, IT services catalogue and IT asset management (hardware & software) inventory.
  • Manage the annual budget for operating and capital expenditures and govern digital workplace technology usage, standards, and licensing to align with IT and company objectives while optimizing costs and enforcing data policies.
  • Contract administration including management of service level for services in the scope including licensing expiration, renewal with different services providers and procurement team.
  • Lead the development, publication and maintenance of the corporate IT catalogue of product and services and its roadmap aligned with business requirements and IT leaders.
  • Provide IT leaders and business with a consolidated overview of IT Service Support KPIs (support tickets and service requests) submitted by the business area, ensuring adherence to SLAs (Service Level Agreements).
  • Champion the modernization of workforce technology and services to enable new ways of working and digital transformation, while demonstrating digital dexterity and fostering a culture of workforce digital dexterity by leading adoption, enablement, and influence to achieve digital business goals.
  • Partner with HR to understand employees’ current challenges, new roles, demographic changes, mobility, hybrid work and more, incorporating this knowledge into digital workplace planning, while utilizing organizational change management best practices to drive technology adoption.
  • Partner with corporate real estate/facilities to create a smart workplace that supports hybrid and remote workers as much as onsite workers.
  • Collaborate with colleagues in internal communications to communicate how digital workplace applications benefit employees through enablement campaigns and measurement of customer satisfaction and eNPS.
  • Work with IT security and risk management to ensure that digital workplace technologies comply with corporate policies and industry standards.
  • Responsible for SOX and ITGC controls within the digital workplace, including the polices creation or update ensuring flawless execution and developing action plans for improvements when necessary.


Main requirements:

  • (5+) years managing IT systems, processes and vendors.
  • (5+) years of leading digital workplace team and processes including external service desk services
  • English mandatory
  • Experience with vendor governance, KPI Management, including demonstrated success in conducting RFPs and vendor service transitions.
  • Proven financial management skills with operational budget tasks.
  • Awareness of ways to measure Digital Experience and satisfaction.
  • Working knowledge of IT frameworks such as ITIL, including key processes – knowledge, incident, change, service request and major-incident management.
  • Proven ability to manage rapidly changing business priorities, processes and technologies.
  • Experience managing a portfolio of digital workplace applications.

Work Environment:

It isn’t just the performance that matters. We also care about the way we achieve our targets. We see our way of working as a differentiator, which contributes to retain the best team, to establish long-term relationships with clients, to expand to other countries, and to attract investors and partners who allow us to generate superior returns:

1. Ethical

  4. Talentos são o nosso core: Somos uma empresa focada em pessoas, não em processos. Não somos apegados a burocracia, acreditamos no potencial do nosso time e a autonomia vem junto com muita responsabilidade. Confiamos uns nos outros e na qualidade das entregas, não perdemos tempo micro gerenciando o time.
  5. Evolução constante: Estamos em um movimento constante de autoavaliação e foco em resolver problemas, buscando melhorar sempre. Caso precisemos, vamos ser rápidos em mudanças para chegar no melhor resultado possível!

Join to apply for the Associate Director, Sales role at Shure Incorporated .

We are seeking a dynamic, experienced Associate Director, Sales to lead Shure’s sales strategy across South America, overseeing the Brazil-based Channel Marketing and Customer Experience teams serving Latin America. The role involves driving revenue growth through channel partnerships, developing go-to-market strategies, strengthening partner engagement, and aligning with Shure’s brand and business objectives. It also includes shaping long-term goals, uncovering new opportunities, and enhancing the end-user experience.

If you have a strong background in sales and marketing leadership, a deep understanding of the Latin American channel ecosystem, and a proven ability to build collaborative relationships that drive customer success, apply now!

Fluency in English, Spanish, and Portuguese is required. This role is based in São Paulo, Brazil.

Responsibilities

  1. Lead the South America sales organization, managing sales performance, growth targets, and margin improvements. Develop and implement strategic plans to exceed sales targets across all product lines.
  2. Provide leadership to the Sales, Channel Marketing, and Customer Experience teams, ensuring alignment, accountability, and high performance. Set goals, coach team members, and foster a culture of innovation and professional growth.
  3. Manage strategic channel accounts, focusing on growth, value creation, and customer journey improvements. Build long-term relationships with top partners and ensure strategic alignment.
  4. Oversee regional channel marketing and customer engagement initiatives in collaboration with the Brazil-based team supporting Latin America. Ensure programs are effective and aligned with sales objectives, contributing to partner enablement and customer success.
  5. Develop and execute regional channel sales plans with cross-functional teams, identifying gaps and opportunities to increase market penetration and partner performance.
  6. Support regional promotions, product launches, events, and training programs in collaboration with internal teams like product marketing, global accounts, and operations.
  7. Represent the voice of Latin American channel partners internally, providing strategic input on global and regional initiatives. Lead regional projects supporting business transformation.
  8. Manage budgeting and forecasting for regional teams, ensuring alignment with business goals and responsible financial management.
  9. Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or related field.
  • 10–12 years of experience in sales and/or channel leadership.
  • 7+ years managing teams and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Knowledge of the professional audio or AV industry is preferred.
  • Experience working with Latin American channel ecosystems.
  • Ability to manage complexity, execute strategies, and lead in a matrix organization.
  • Proficiency in Salesforce or similar CRM tools.
  • Strong executive presence and communication skills.
  • Ability to inspire and motivate diverse teams.
  • Willingness to travel up to 75%.
  • Languages: Fluency in English, Spanish, and Portuguese.

Who We Are

Shure’s mission is to be the most trusted audio brand worldwide. Founded in 1925, we are a leading manufacturer of audio equipment, known for quality, reliability, and durability. We engineer microphones, headphones, wireless systems, and more. We foster an inclusive culture, offering flexible work arrangements and opportunities for all.

Headquartered in the United States, we have over 35 regional offices, engineering hubs, and manufacturing facilities across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia.

The Mix Matters

If you don’t meet every requirement but are excited about this role and share our values, we encourage you to apply. We are committed to an inclusive, diverse, equitable, and accessible workplace.

title: [Talent Pool] Investor XP | Porto Alegre
description:
Sobre nós

Nossa história começou em 2001, com um pequeno escritório de agentes autônomos de investimentos em Porto Alegre e hoje somos um grande ecossistema de serviços financeiros, mídia e educação.

Chegamos até aqui com a dedicação de equipes talentosas que tiveram garra, determinação, resiliência e, acima de tudo, ambição de fazer o impossível.

Nossos valores

  • Foco no cliente: Somos obstinados em superar as expectativas dos nossos clientes.
  • Sonho grande: Miramos no impossível, acreditamos que ele pode se tornar realidade, e chegamos lá juntos.
  • Mente aberta: Nossa abertura para o novo e nossa capacidade de adaptação são o que nos fazem evoluir e melhorar sempre.
  • Espírito empreendedor: Construímos o futuro com nossas próprias mãos com o mais alto nível de comprometimento e sentimento de dono.

Sobre a oportunidade

Esta rede é direcionada a pessoas plenos e sêniores que buscam atuar como Investor na XP Inc na região de Porto Alegre. Temos vagas previstas para serem abertas em 2024 com diversas senioridades na estrutura. Caso seu perfil faça sentido para alguma destas vagas , entraremos em contato, convidando para avançar no processo seletivo.

Como Investor do time de Estratégia XP , você ficará responsável por trabalhar o asset allocation dos clientes de forma sofisticada, garantindo o enquadramento dos portfólios, de acordo com o suitability de cada cliente.

O Investor ocupa a posição de referência técnica para o segmento e, além de garantir a qualidade na alocação dos clientes, atua sendo interface direta com as áreas de negócio da companhia, pensando estrategicamente quais ativos devem ser trabalhados e quais perfis de cliente têm maior propensão para determinada oferta. Geram insumos comerciais para todo o time, através de treinamentos, dados, materiais, etc.

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Atender os principais clientes da XP, em conjunto com o Banker do cliente;
  • Ser referência técnica sobre produtos, planejamento financeiro e asset allocation no segmento;
  • Identificar as melhores oportunidades de investimentos, garantindo assertividade comercial;
  • Construir e disseminar as melhores práticas de investimentos entre os assessores;
  • Realizar consultoria de investimentos para garantir excelência no atendimento e monitorar os indicadores de qualidade;
  • Atuar no nível tático e estratégico junto às áreas que impactam direta e indiretamente o cliente final.

Pré-requisitos:

  • Ter a nossa cultura;
  • Perfil comercial e relacional;
  • Sólido conhecimento sobre produtos financeiros (RV, RF, Fundos, Previdência, entre outros);
  • Conhecimento sobre asset allocation, enquadramento, inteligência de base;
  • Conhecimentos de macroeconomia e sua conjuntura atual;
  • Experiência atendendo clientes Private ou Alta Renda;
  • CFP ou CGA ou CFG;

Diferenciais:

  • CFA ou outras certificações.

Modelo de trabalho:

  • Presencial em Porto Alegre e proximidades.

Benefícios que oferecemos:

  • Saúde e bem-estar: plano de saúde, plano odontológico, Gympass, Zenklub, VA, VR, New Value, seguro de vida.
  • Maternidade e Paternidade: auxílio creche para pais e mães, licença maternidade de 6 meses, licença paternidade de 20 dias.
  • Só na XP Inc.: assessoria de investimento e acesso a fundos de investimentos exclusivos.

Jornada de trabalho com flexibilidade

O nosso modelo de trabalho varia de acordo com a função: preferencialmente presencial para frentes de negócio, predominantemente remoto para times de tecnologia e híbrido para as demais equipes. É importante ressaltar que todos os colaboradores precisam morar na localidade da vaga (nossa sede está localizada na cidade de São Paulo e é onde temos o maior número de posições), já que temos atividades que exigem a presença física para promover a colaboração e os rituais da nossa cultura. Esses encontros são organizados de acordo com as orientações dos líderes e as particularidades de cada rotina, para que nossos colaboradores possam exercer suas jornadas de trabalho com liberdade e autonomia.

title: Waste Management Specialist (Summer 2025-2026) - Palmer Station
description:
POSITION: Waste Management Specialist

SEASON: Austral Summer (October - April)

LOCATION: Palmer Station, Antarctica

SECTOR/DEPT: Six Mile, LLC Antarctica

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  1. Act as point of contact for Waste Management and attend weekly staff meetings and teleconferences.
  2. Collect and package for shipment all solid and hazardous wastes on station.
  3. Follow all SOPs associated with position duties.
  4. Ensure proper documentation and filing of all paperwork on time.
  5. Review/update JHA and SDS binders and computer folders.
  6. Use proper PPE for various tasks (correct gloves, respirator, safety glasses, etc.).
  7. Quality check all shipping containers and correct discrepancies immediately.
  8. Process hazardous and radioactive waste per SOPs, including marking, labeling, weighing, and storing.
  9. Perform classification qualitative testing on items (pH testing, flash point testing, etc.).
  10. Consolidate and lab pack wastes as required per profile and classification.
  11. Safely operate various pieces of equipment on station (SkyTraks, ATVs, etc.).
  12. Store processed hazardous wastes according to segregation requirements.
  13. Keep waste inventory records updated and accurate.
  14. Perform quality-assurance checks on inventory database and files.
  15. Provide hazardous waste, solid waste, and spill briefings.
  16. Act as Spill Team Lead for the entire station, write spill reports, and conduct trainings and drills.
  17. Organize, orient, and train members of Spill Team for outside spill response.
  18. Maintain inventory of spill supplies in spill-vans and satellite spill kits.
  19. Assist station mechanic with weekly station fueling activities.
  20. Maintain/deploy spill-boom supplies for station fueling.
  21. Assist with general station needs, including snow removal and radio communications.
  22. Conduct community Waste Briefs or other informational sessions as necessary.
  23. Collect and process Resale Items as needed.
  24. Maintain Maximo Resale work orders and provide end of season report to McMurdo Resale Admin and ASC Property Manager.
  25. Maintain a flexible schedule based on Vessel Operations and other station-wide activities.
  26. Ensure seasonal replacement receives proper training and maintain a log of this information.
  27. Troubleshoot any issues that arise and elevate them as needed.
  28. Supply manual labor (shoveling) for several hours if needed.
  29. Perform regular use of drum dollies, cargo straps, banding, shovels, pallet jacks, power tools, and other tools.
  30. Engage in regular physical activity, including bending, lifting, carrying, reaching, and gripping.
  31. Display self-motivation in a physically challenging and atypical work environment; position is approximately 70% outdoor tasking.
  32. Maintain flexibility and a positive attitude in a dynamic, fast-paced work setting.
  33. Perform duties in support of Operations Division metrics.
  34. Support the achievement of ASC metrics.
  35. Comply with all ASC Environmental Health & Safety and Quality Assurance requirements.
  36. Work to achieve ASC goals and contractual commitments.
  37. Maintain a safe workplace and ensure that safety is the highest priority.
  38. Perform other duties as required.
  39. Reports to Hazardous Waste Manager and Solid Waste Manager.

REQUIREMENTS:

  1. 2 years of USAP Waste Management experience.
  2. College degree (2 additional years of experience will substitute).
  3. Strong computer software experience.
  4. Able to lift 50 pounds consistently and wear a respirator.
  5. Valid Driver's License and Passport valid for six months after contract end.
  6. Physically able to be active for 9 hours daily.
  7. Must pass physical qualification assessment.
  8. Able to deploy to Antarctica for length of contract.

PREFERRED:

  1. 1 year of Hazardous Materials shipping/characterization or reporting experience or 2 years of Environmental remediation.
  2. 1 year of supervisory experience.
  3. 1 year of High School Chemistry or equivalent.
  4. 1 quarter of college General Chemistry.
  5. College degree in Chemistry or Environmental Science.
  6. OSHA HazWOPER 40-Hour certification, current.
  7. Familiarity with power tools and machinery.
  8. Equipment operating experience.
  9. Previous management or supervisory experience.

EDUCATION:

College degree (2 additional years of experience will substitute).

CERTIFICATIONS AND/OR LICENSING REQUIREMENTS:

Valid Driver's License and passport valid for six months after end of contract.

OTHER:

US citizenship or permanent residency required.

description:
Horário: De segunda à sexta, das 8h às 18h com horário de almoço
Modalidade: Presencial
Descrição:

Principais Responsabilidades

1. Inspeções e Auditorias de Segurança

• Realizar inspeções periódicas nas instalações da empresa para identificar riscos e oportunidades de melhoria.

• Conduzir auditorias internas e externas em conformidade com as Normas Regulamentadoras (NRs) e demais legislações aplicáveis.

• Acompanhar as condições de trabalho, instalações, máquinas e equipamentos, promovendo melhorias contínuas nas práticas de segurança.

2. Gestão e Implementação de Normas de Segurança

• Garantir o cumprimento das normas legais e internas de segurança do trabalho, por meio da elaboração, revisão e atualização de procedimentos.

• Supervisionar e garantir o uso correto dos Equipamentos de Proteção Individual (EPIs) e Coletiva (EPCs), orientando os colaboradores quanto à sua utilização.

3. Treinamentos e Conscientização

• Planejar e realizar treinamentos periódicos de segurança, primeiros socorros, combate a incêndios, manuseio de EPIs e operação segura de máquinas.

• Promover campanhas e ações de conscientização voltadas à cultura de prevenção de acidentes.

• Conduzir simulados de evacuação e resposta a emergências.

4. Investigação de Acidentes e Incidentes

• Investigar acidentes e quase acidentes, identificando causas raízes e elaborando planos de ação corretiva e preventiva.

• Emitir relatórios técnicos com análises e indicadores de desempenho em segurança.

5. Gestão de Documentação e Relatórios

• Manter atualizados os registros legais e operacionais de segurança do trabalho: controle de EPIs, treinamentos, PPRA/PGR, PCMSO, LTCAT, CAT, entre outros.

• Elaborar relatórios gerenciais e indicadores de SST para acompanhamento estratégico da área.

6. Gestão de Riscos Ambientais e Ocupacionais

• Identificar, avaliar e controlar riscos ambientais e ocupacionais, conforme legislação vigente.

• Apoiar ações de controle de substâncias químicas, descarte de resíduos e demais práticas de segurança ambiental.

7. Gestão de Terceiros e Prestadores de Serviços

• Acompanhar e garantir que os terceiros cumpram os requisitos legais e internos de segurança durante suas atividades na empresa.

• Elaborar, revisar e validar documentação de segurança exigida de terceiros (como PCMSO, PGR, ASO, treinamentos e permissões de trabalho).

• Promover integração e treinamentos específicos de segurança para terceiros, reforçando o alinhamento com a cultura da empresa.

8. Gestão do AVCB (Auto de Vistoria do Corpo de Bombeiros)

• Gerir o processo de obtenção, renovação e manutenção do AVCB da empresa.

• Coordenar as adequações necessárias para atendimento às exigências do Corpo de Bombeiros, como sistemas de combate a incêndios, sinalizações e rotas de fuga.

• Manter controle rigoroso sobre a validade e documentação de licenças relacionadas à segurança contra incêndio.

9. Gestão do eSocial – Saúde e Segurança do Trabalho (SST)

• Garantir o correto preenchimento e envio das informações de SST no eSocial, dentro dos prazos legais.

• Trabalhar em conjunto com o RH para atualização dos eventos de segurança e saúde ocupacional.

• Controlar e registrar eventos como acidentes de trabalho, exames médicos e treinamentos obrigatórios no sistema.

10. Apoio em Projetos de Segurança e Melhoria Contínua

• Participar da implementação de projetos e soluções voltadas à melhoria da segurança no ambiente de trabalho.

• Atuar de forma consultiva com outras áreas, promovendo a integração da segurança com os processos produtivos e administrativos.

11. Gestão Patrimonial e Operacional de Serviços Terceirizados

• Monitorar e controlar a integridade do patrimônio da empresa, incluindo instalações, equipamentos e áreas comuns.

• Supervisionar os serviços terceirizados de portaria, vigilância, jardinagem e limpeza, assegurando o cumprimento de cronogramas, padrões de qualidade e normas de segurança.

• Garantir que os prestadores de serviços patrimoniais estejam devidamente documentados, treinados e integrados às políticas da empresa.

• Atuar na melhoria contínua dos serviços terceirizados, propondo ajustes contratuais, treinamentos ou reestruturações quando necessário.

• Acompanhar e auditar o uso e conservação de áreas comuns, zelando pela ordem, segurança e limpeza do ambiente de trabalho.


Requisitos:

Requisitos

• Curso Técnico em Segurança do Trabalho (com registro ativo).

• Experiência anterior na função, preferencialmente no setor industrial.

• Conhecimento aprofundado das NRs e da legislação vigente.

• Experiência comprovada em gestão de terceiros e controle documental de prestadores de serviços.

• Vivência em gestão de riscos ambientais e ocupacionais.

• Domínio da plataforma eSocial, com foco nos eventos de SST.

• Experiência na gestão do AVCB e rotinas de segurança contra incêndio.

• Vivência com gestão patrimonial (limpeza, vigilância, portaria, manutenção predial).

• Habilidade para ministrar treinamentos, elaborar relatórios técnicos e conduzir investigações.

• Habilidades com KPI SST

• Perfil proativo, organizado, com boa comunicação e foco em resultados.

description:
Description

ADP is hiring a Lead Developer Frontend – Lyric Team

  • Are you empathetic to client needs and inspired by transformation and impacting the lives of millions of people every day?
  • Are you looking tojoin a dynamic, inclusiveteam environmentwith a culture of collaboration and belonging?

In this role, you will work within a scrum team to bring the designs and ideas to life for new or improved web applications. This work will support a mix of internal and external clients. You will work with clients, product managers, architects, software engineers, and more to plan, design, develop, test, and implement impactful solutions that support companies with one to millions of employees.

You will start your day on a scrum call to prioritize and track work. Within the team you work on, you will choose user stories to work within a sprint cycle. You will spend most of your day developing and testing your code. Every three weeks, you will be involved in the release activities.

As a Lead Developer Frontend, you will work closely with your team to lead and guide projects to success. You'll have a hands-on role designing, developing, debugging, and deploying software solutions where you can leverage your expertise with code complexities. You'll also serve as a mentor to the junior developers. In the senior role, you will balance the assigning of user stories through prioritization and consideration of the technical interests of each developer on the team. As part of our team, you'll find exciting challenges, get opportunities to grow your career, and develop solid friendships as we design what's next for ADP and the industry. Pace should not scare you. We still find time for a healthy dose of fun.

Hybrid work model, reporting directly to our Porto Alegre Office location.

To thrive in this development career, you'll need to be an expert in:

  • Strong knowledge of Angular, React or Stencil.JS and Micro Frontend;
  • Should be able to write clean code passing sonar quality gate passing;
  • Experience in the frontend environment;
  • Advanced English;

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

You'll start each day with a scrum, working in a team to understand responsibilities, identify issues, and communicate coding priorities while choosing user stories to complete. You will also participate in other agile ceremonies, including scheduled sprint demos, where you will present your work to up to 90 stakeholders.

  • Build teams that thrive. As an experienced leader, you want everyone to shine. You'll start each day by checking in with your engineering team to identify priorities and challenges. You'll find a way to make the team's day go smoother. You are constantly looking for ways to share your knowledge, motivate others and keep everyone engaged and productive.
  • Build Products. You will use your technical expertise to review your team's work and help your people excel in an Agile environment. You're proactive and hands-on. When you see a potential issue, you never leave things hanging and unfinished. When you and your team deliver a finished product, it's as polished as you could make it.
  • Variety of work. There is no typical day. You could be checking in with a team in India one minute, meeting with leadership to review initiatives for the coming quarter later and tomorrow handling a few ad hoc requests from your peers in other departments.

YOU'LL LOVE WORKING HERE BECAUSE YOU CAN:

  • Have courageous team collaboration. Courage comes from how associates are willing to have difficult conversations, speak up, be an owner, and challenge one another's ideas to find the best solution.
  • Deliver at epic scale. We deliver real user outcomes using strong judgment and good instincts. We're obsessed with the art of achieving simplicity with a focus on client happiness and productivity.
  • Be surrounded by curious learners. We align ourselves with other smart people in an environment where we grow and elevate one another to the next level. We encourage our associates to listen, stay agile, and learn from mistakes.
  • Act like an owner & doer. Mission-driven and committed to leading change, you will be encouraged to take on any challenge and solve complex problems. No tasks are beneath or too great for us. We are hands-on and willing to master our craft.
  • Give back to others. Always do the right thing for our clients and our community and humbly give back to the community where we live and work. Support our associates in times of need through ADP's Philanthropic Foundation.
  • Join a company committed to equality and equity. Our goal is to impact lasting change through our actions.

Somos uma indústria especializada em soluções tecnológicas para a manutenção preditiva de ativos industriais. O objetivo da nossa solução é transformar a indústria, tornando-a mais segura e mais produtiva do que ontem.

Ao produzirmos os hardwares e softwares da nossa solução, buscamos apresentar aos nossos clientes e parceiros o porquê de sermos referência em soluções eficientes e eficazes para monitoramento, manutenção e performance de ativos. Além disso, reconhecemos e valorizamos a diversidade de habilidades e experiências que cada pessoa possui. Nosso compromisso é garantir oportunidades igualitárias para todos os talentos, respeitando a singularidade de cada indivíduo e promovendo um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo e acolhedor.

Além disso, temos orgulho de possuir as certificações das ISOs 9001, 27001, 27018, 27701. Por meio delas, promovemos a organização e a estrutura de nossos processos, resultando em um ambiente de trabalho mais organizado e eficiente.

Conheça mais sobre nós, visite nosso site .

Sobre a equipe na qual você irá atuar:

O nosso Marketing apresenta ao mundo a Dynamox e as grandes parcerias que se tornaram cases de sucesso. Nossos profissionais de marketing – de marca, vídeo, conteúdo e desempenho – são responsáveis por manter a qualidade dos assuntos que permeiam nosso dia a dia, apresentando as narrativas para que nossos clientes e potenciais clientes nos enxerguem como nós os enxergamos, de forma única.

A equipe é robusta e isso nos permite construir parcerias de qualidade com nossas outras equipes internas: Produto, Comercial, CS, conseguindo assim excelência no que fazemos.

Atividades do cargo:

  • Executar e aprimorar as demandas institucionais de Design gráfico e de mídias da Dynamox;
  • Produzir materiais com abordagem comercial, como banners, folders, cartazes, apresentações, design de brindes, etc;
  • Criar elementos visuais para ações, campanhas e lançamentos de materiais de marketing, alinhados à estratégia visual da marca;
  • Apoiar a elaboração de uma estratégia de comunicação para parceiros de integração e canais oficiais;
  • Criar e apoiar estratégias de marca escaláveis e eficazes, incluindo posicionamento, arquitetura, nomenclatura e mensagens para o ecossistema da Dynamox;
  • Criar conceitos visuais impactantes que transmitam efetivamente a identidade da marca e os objetivos de marketing;
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com os times de conteúdo, atração e conversão, social media e design branding, garantindo uma abordagem integrada e consistente em todas as iniciativas de design e marketing;

Requisitos:

  • Compreensão dos princípios de tipografia, layout e composição visual para criar designs esteticamente atraentes e funcionais;
  • Capacidade de editar e retocar imagens de forma criativa e profissional, aplicando técnicas de edição, recorte e manipulação de fotos;
