title: Associate Manager, Marketing Innovation (New Channel Growth)
description:
About Agoda

Agoda is an online travel booking platform for accommodations, flights, and more. We build and deploy cutting-edge technology that connects travelers with a global network of 4.7M hotels and holiday properties worldwide, plus flights, activities, and more. Based in Asia and part of Booking Holdings, our 7,100+ employees representing 95+ nationalities in 27 markets foster a work environment rich in diversity, creativity, and collaboration. We innovate through a culture of experimentation and ownership,enhancing the ability for our customers to experience the world.

Our Purpose - Bridging the World Through Travel

We believe travel allows people to enjoy, learn and experience more of the amazing world we live in. It brings individuals and cultures closer together, fostering empathy, understanding and happiness.We are a skillful, driven and diverse team from across the globe, united by a passion to make an impact. Harnessing our innovative technologies and strong partnerships, we aim to make travel easy and rewarding for everyone.

Get to Know ourTeam:

The Marketing Innovations Team at Agoda identifies & develops new marketing channels that have high growth potential. This department is highly creative, data-driven and focused on developing at-scale marketing programs that ensure Agoda’s leadership in the new & emerging channels. The team is a blend of the best analysts, marketing strategists, and data scientists in the world. The marketing leadership at Agoda have deep experience in data science, product, strategy, and other marketing fields and have built an organization that thrives on data, creative ideas, and technology. The Marketing Innovations Team also fosters a great learning environment. You will be able to learn and grow by working closely with experts from a variety of backgrounds from all over the world.

In this role, you’ll getto:

  • Spearhead the development, execution, and optimization strategy for growing Agoda's new & emerging marketing channels
  • Conduct end-to-end analysis of large, complex datasets related to channel performance, user behavior, and market trends, translating raw data into actionable insights
  • Develop hypotheses, design experiments (e.g., A/B tests), and build structured analyses to rigorously evaluate campaign effectiveness and drive data-driven decisions for channel growth
  • Partner closely with various business functions to identify opportunities, analyze, and interpret trends or patterns in complex data sets using different techniques and tools such as SQL or Tableau
  • Communicate complex findings, performance updates, and strategic recommendations clearly and concisely to key stakeholders, including senior management.

What you’ll need to succeed:

  • Extensive Experience:5+ years in Data Analyst position or otherwise in projects involving big data —preferably in the tech, e-commerce, or digital marketing industry. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science/Statistics/Math or Engineering or Economics and Finance is a plus.
  • Data-Driven Approach:Strong analytical skills with the ability to analyze data, translate data into actionable insights, and generate impactful recommendations.Proficient in business intelligence tools and data warehouse i.e. SQL, Tableau and MS Excel
  • Innovative Problem-Solving Skills: The ability to tackle complex challenges in a non-linear fashion is essential. We seek a resourceful candidate who can effectively navigate the organization to gather necessary information and implement innovative solutions while adapting to evolving scenarios and leveraging valuable resources creatively.
  • Strong Communication Skills:Exceptional writing and verbal communication abilities, with proficiency in creating impactful and visually appealing presentations.
  • Stakeholder management: Ability to effectively communicate, influence and persuade with different levels of stakeholders (including Senior Management) with proven strong commercial acumen

It’s great if you have:

  • Experience in digital or social media marketing
  • Experience in hypothesis testing frameworks, statistical analysis, and using Python/R for data manipulation and analysis.

Os selecionados passarão por imersão no Projeto, recebendo treinamento sobre as atividades e uso dos sistemas de inspeção, a primeira fase de seleção é realizada integralmente online.

Buscamos profissionais que incorporem nossos valores, não têm medo de desafios, busquem inovar, experimentar e se aprimorar rapidamente. Nosso objetivo é contratar e reter os indivíduos mais brilhantes, oferecendo crescimento profissional e oportunidades de desenvolvimento em toda a carreira. Se é você, adoraríamos conversar.

Sobre a oportunidade:

Estamos buscando Auditores Agrícolas que contribuirão com atividades de coleta de dados através do acompanhamento de testes transgênicos em pontos de recebimento de soja (PDR's) em silos, armazéns e cooperativas. Nossa missão é oferecer serviços e soluções inovadoras para garantir que os ativos, produtos e processos de nossos mais de 400 mil clientes atendam a padrões e regulamentos em termos de qualidade, saúde, segurança, proteção ambiental e responsabilidade social.

  2. Revisão das informações coletadas em campo;
  3. Comunicação tempestiva com os líderes alinhamento das divergências encontradas;
  4. Verificação de formulários e validação dos dados coletados em campo;

  9. Facilidade em manuseio de tecnologias (tablets e smartphone);

As vagas são temporárias, para atuação nos estados do Rio Grande do Sul, Paraná e Santa Catarina. Em caso de viagens a empresa custeia todas as despesas: deslocamento entre as cidades de origem e de atuação, hospedagem, transporte, alimentação, lavanderia, internet.

  • Strategy Development: Define and establish quality standards and testing strategies to ensure product reliability and performance.

Who You Are

  • Experience: Minimum 3 years in automated testing environments.
  • Test Automation Expertise: Strong background in test automation, framework design, and development using tools like Selenium, Appium, or Cypress for front-end and JMeter, K6, or Rest-assured for back-end.

Desirable Qualifications

title: Engineering Manager
description:
Join to apply for the Engineering Manager role at Digibee

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

About Digibee

Digibee is an iPaaS that scales integration workflows while reducing cost and technical debt. Rather than require specialized integration experts, Digibee lets every developer quickly build, test, deploy, govern, and monitor integrations across on-premise and cloud environments using a simple but powerful low-code interface.

Founded in São Paulo, Brazil, in 2017 and headquartered in Weston, Florida, our team is widely distributed throughout the Americas. In May of 2023, Digibee closed a Series B funding round of $60 million that is intended to drive our expansion in the United States.

About the role

This role offers a unique opportunity to shape the future of our integration technology and extend its functionalities. You will be responsible for both technical and managerial leadership, driving innovation and performance while ensuring alignment with organizational goals.

On a typical day, you will…

Technical Leadership

  • Lead the team responsible for the development and maintenance of our microservices-based core integration engine.
  • Lead the team focused on extending the engine capabilities through the development of connectors, triggers, and other add-ons.
  • Propose technical hypotheses and drive R&D efforts to improve system capabilities.
  • Ensure proper architecture for a highly distributed system.
  • Work closely with the technical team, participating in code reviews, discussions, and validating the use of best practices.

High-Performance Focus

  • Drive initiatives focused on optimizing application performance, ensuring the highest levels of efficiency and reliability.
  • Dive deep into technology and pay attention to details to guarantee high-quality outputs.
  • Prioritize and execute performance benchmarks and load testing to validate system scalability and stability.

Operational Excellence

  • Oversee end-to-end deployment pipelines, ensuring that software is not just delivered but also effectively runs in production environments.
  • Foster a culture of operational excellence within the team, emphasizing reliability, monitoring, and incident response.

People Leadership

  • Lead a team of engineers; mentor and guide them through their career development.
  • Hire new team members and manage performance, including dismissals when necessary.
  • Lead and manage budget allocation for the teams.
  • Ensure teams meet project milestones and delivery timelines.
  • English proficiency is required for effective communication with our global team and partners.
  • Communicate effectively with cross-functional teams and upper management.

What You'll Need To Bring...

  • Strong experience with React, Java, Kubernetes, and other related technologies.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and a knack for technical innovation.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and experience in managing people.
  • Experience with high-performance and high-throughput applications.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Proficiency in English is required for effective communication with our global team.

It's a plus if you have...

  • Prior experience in a fast-paced, startup environment.
  • Familiarity with various integration frameworks and a strong commitment to open-source contributions.
  • Familiarity with the OKR (Objectives and Key Results) methodology is a plus

Our Perks And Benefits

  • We're remote first, with a flexible working schedule
  • Health care
  • R$ 1.200,00/month on Caju card (for food and meal allowance, mobility, home office supplies, culture, health, and education)
  • Life insurance
  • Child care assistance
  • Gympass
  • English course: we have a partnership for group classes for R$100 monthly

Our culture

We believe in a highly collaborative work environment to foster constant development and exchange between teams. We encourage learning, sharing knowledge, and using new technologies to create disruptive ideas — we want to create something great together! At Digibee, we value diversity and are dedicated to a supportive, respectful culture.

title: Gerente de Vendas | Bombas e Rodovias
description:
Você conhece a Sany do Brasil? Fundada em 1989 em Changsha, na China, o Grupo Sany dedica-se à produção de máquinas pesadas, tendo como principais produtos as máquinas para construção civil, pavimentação, escavação, reach stacker, guindastes, máquinas portuárias e de mineração.

Há 20 anos, o Grupo Sany tem conquistado progresso e sucesso na sua jornada. Possui dez fábricas na China, uma na Índia, uma na Alemanha e uma nos Estados Unidos, além de aplicar políticas agressivas como a de dedicar 5% de seu faturamento anual em pesquisa e desenvolvimento de novas tecnologias. Em 2012, a Sany adquiriu a empresa alemã Putzmeister, formando o maior líder mundial na área de equipamentos para concreto.

Atualmente, a Sany emprega cerca de 40 mil colaboradores em mais de 150 países. No Brasil, a trajetória do Grupo Sany começou em 2007, inicialmente como importador de equipamentos. Em 2011, consolidou sua presença no país com investimentos de aproximadamente US$ 200 milhões. Nesse mesmo ano, inaugurou sua primeira unidade fabril em São José dos Campos, SP, com 30 mil m², para montagem de escavadeiras e guindastes sobre caminhão, no regime CKD (Completely Knock-Down). Em 2012, recebeu a certificação de qualidade ISO 9001:2008 pela Fundação Carlos Alberto Vanzolini, garantindo rigorosos processos de qualidade e segurança.

Em 2013, iniciou a montagem de guindastes RT (rough terrain) e rolos compactadores em sua unidade de fabricação. No final de 2017, inaugurou instalações em Jacareí/SP. A Sany possui uma rede de distribuidores e filiais próprias para oferecer produtos e serviços de pós-venda em todo o Brasil.

Como nosso Gerente de Vendas, você irá:

  • Desenvolver e implementar o plano estratégico de vendas para o portfólio de Bombas e Rodovias;
  • Gerenciar o funil de vendas, desde a prospecção até o fechamento de contratos, garantindo a satisfação do cliente;
  • Identificar oportunidades de mercado e novas demandas, analisando concorrência, tendências e potencial de clientes;
  • Construir e manter relacionamentos com stakeholders do setor;
  • Realizar visitas técnicas e comerciais, apresentações de produtos e negociações;
  • Colaborar com as áreas de engenharia, pós-vendas e operações para garantir soluções técnicas adequadas e cumprimento de prazos;
  • Acompanhar indicadores de desempenho da área comercial (KPIs), como volume de vendas, margem, rentabilidade e forecast;
  • Participar de feiras, eventos e fóruns do setor portuário e logístico para promover a marca e gerar novos negócios.

Requisitos para se candidatar:

  • Experiência comprovada em vendas técnicas, preferencialmente no setor de Bombas e Rodovias;
  • Atuação prévia com negociações complexas (grandes contas, projetos sob medida, contratos de longo prazo);
  • Vivência no relacionamento com clientes B2B e na gestão de ciclo de vendas consultivo;

Solutions Specialist LATAM (CAD/BIM software)

Bricsys, part of Hexagon, is a global technology company creating innovative Computer Aided Design software for worldwide markets. Our products enable the world’s most innovative companies to streamline complex design workflows every day. Our people are active in 80 countries, and our software is available in fifteen languages. We are currently looking for an experienced Solutions Specialist to join our LATAM Presales team.

You will collaborate closely with our regional (pre)sales team and work with our channel partners in the region to understand client needs, demonstrate product capabilities, and develop tailored solutions that align with customer requirements.

The role is offered on a regular, full-time employment contract basis and can be performed remotely in Brazil.

Your key responsibilities will be to:

  • Align with key customer stakeholders to secure business and technical closure of the proposed Bricsys solution.
  • Provide consultancy and best practices for project implementation.
  • Develop and maintain trusted working relationships with Bricsys Reseller Network & Territory Sales.
  • Communicate and materialize clients’ needs with customized solutions.
  • Polish relationships with clients, partners, vendors, and external parties.
  • Conduct sales & channel enablement, including industry and/or product sales demonstrations.
  • Establish and maintain industry leadership through competitive studies and in-depth knowledge of technologies impacting customers & global technology marketplace.
  • Establish workflow and framework for new technology implementation.
  • Manage training and workshops for BIM/VDC related software.

We are looking for:

Skills:

  • Clear passion and commitment to be an innovator.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a consultative approach to sales.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a remote team environment.
  • Understanding of how to define BIM scope, integrate workflow processes, set up standards, manage key stakeholders, and monitor performance.
  • Ability to lead the production and quality assurance processes.
  • Ability to plan and optimize CAD technology implementation.
  • Ability to support pre-sales activities and research, propose and evaluate the latest CAD and BIM technology.

Knowledge:

  • Extensive knowledge of CAD/BIM technology.
  • Extensive knowledge of AEC, BIM and/or Manufacturing sectors in the region and their challenges.
  • Strong knowledge of channel partner/reseller model and developing channel partner relationships.

Experience:

  • 10+ years' professional experience in roles combining technical capabilities and commercial skills, such as Principal Consultant, Implementation Manager, Solution Architect, Practice Manager, Technical Presales Consultant, Application Engineer, or similar.
  • Previous hands-on user experience with CAD/BIM solutions demonstrating a strong understanding of their applications and functionalities.
  • Demonstrable experience researching, evaluating, analyzing, and delivering CAD technology.
  • Demonstrable experience in content development and delivery of CAD software demos, consultancy, workshops, and training.
  • Demonstrable experience establishing BIM workflows and frameworks for new technology implementations.

Education & Other Qualifications:

  • Preferred qualifications in either Architecture, Building Management, or Engineering.
  • Proficiency in English, Portuguese, and Spanish.
  • Availability to travel in the region as needed for client and partner engagements, as well as industry events.

If you are a passionate and driven professional, we invite you to join our team at Bricsys. This represents an excellent opportunity for the right candidate to join a fast-paced, exciting company on a mission to delight our customers and deliver significant growth.

Interested? We look forward to hearing from you!

description:
Why join us

TRACTIAN is transforming the industrial world by empowering frontline maintenance workers to achieve more. We’ve fused cutting-edge hardware with innovative software into one powerful platform, disrupting legacy systems and delivering smarter, faster solutions for our clients.

At TRACTIAN, you'll break boundaries, question convention, and collaborate with top talent to drive real change. As a part of our growth-stage startup, you’ll work alongside the founders, shaping the vision, products, and experiences that will define the future of industrial tech.

Finance at TRACTIAN

The Finance team at TRACTIAN is responsible for managing the company’s financial health and ensuring sustainable growth. This team oversees financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and analysis, ensuring that all departments have the resources they need to operate efficiently. They also manage financial reporting and compliance, working closely with other departments to ensure alignment with the company’s strategic goals. Finance is key to driving profitability, managing cash flow, and ensuring that TRACTIAN maintains a healthy financial foundation as it scales.

What you'll do

As a Senior FP&A Analyst, you will lead financial planning, forecasting, and reporting processes to provide strategic insights that support key business decisions. Working closely with senior management, you will deliver actionable financial data, improve forecasting accuracy, and drive financial performance across the organization. This role requires strong analytical skills, a deep understanding of financial metrics, and the ability to communicate complex financial concepts clearly to non-financial stakeholders.

  • Lead monthly and quarterly financial forecasting and budgeting processes to ensure accuracy and alignment with business goals.
  • Prepare detailed financial reports and performance analyses to guide strategic decision-making.

  • Build and maintain robust financial models for budgeting, forecasting, and scenario planning.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure financial goals are aligned with organizational objectives.
  • Deliver clear, data-driven presentations on monthly financial performance versus budget to the management team.
,

description:
Venha fazer parte do Grupo Modena & Silva, estamos presente nos estados de Rondônia, Amazonas e Pará, com a missão de satisfazer as necessidades de seus clientes, atuando com excelência e agilidade nos atendimentos.

Contamos com a rede FARMARCAS, que se destaca no mercado farmacêutico por sua gestão eficiente de drogarias. A rede acredita que cuidar de pessoas é fundamental para o reconhecimento como a melhor empresa de gestão de agrupamentos de drogarias do Brasil.

Resumo da Posição:

Estamos em busca de um profissional para vaga de Analista Contábil Sênior para suprir a frente de trabalho de Orçamento e Planejamento . O profissional será responsável por coletar informações das áreas operacionais para planejamento anual, provisões e acompanhamento de resultados. Elaborar orçamentos e projeções de curto e longo prazo, e participar na definição de metas. Fornecer análises para apoio à tomada de decisões estratégicas e elaboração de relatórios para a alta gestão. Acompanhar indicadores chave de desempenho (KPIs) e garantir serviços e fluxos.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  1. Desenvolver e revisar o orçamento anual: Participar da elaboração do orçamento da empresa, considerando projeções de receitas, custos e despesas, alinhados com a estratégia e metas da organização.
  2. Acompanhamento do desempenho orçamentário: Monitorar e analisar o desempenho real versus o orçamento, identificando variações significativas e trabalhando com as áreas para corrigir desvios.
  3. Revisões de Orçamento: Realizar projeções financeiras periódicas, ajustando o orçamento com base nas mudanças de cenário e nas novas previsões de receitas e despesas.
  4. Análise de variações: Analisar as variações entre o realizado e o orçado, investigando as causas das diferenças e propondo ações corretivas.
  5. Relatórios comparativos: Preparar relatórios financeiros detalhados, explicando as variações orçamentárias e fornecendo dados para a tomada de decisões estratégicas.
  6. Suporte à tomada de decisão: Fornecer análises financeiras detalhadas para suportar decisões estratégicas, como novos investimentos, expansões ou ajustes operacionais.
  7. Planejamento de cenários: Desenvolver cenários financeiros baseados em diferentes premissas, ajudando a empresa a se preparar para diferentes possibilidades de mercado e desempenho.
  8. Apoio ao planejamento de longo prazo: Trabalhar em conjunto com as equipes executivas no planejamento financeiro de médio e longo prazo, considerando as projeções de receitas e necessidades de investimento.
  9. Conciliação de contas: Garantir a correta conciliação contábil de contas que envolvem o orçamento, como contas de receitas, custos e despesas, com as movimentações orçamentárias.
  10. Interface com a contabilidade: Colaborar com a equipe contábil para assegurar que as informações contábeis estejam alinhadas com as projeções orçamentárias.
  11. Análise de rentabilidade de projetos e áreas: Avaliar a rentabilidade de diferentes áreas ou produtos da empresa, colaborando com outros departamentos para otimizar recursos e investimentos.

Requisitos necessários:

  • Ensino superior Completo em Ciências Contabéis, Administração, Economia, ou áreas afins.
  • Domínio do pacote Office.
  • Domínio das normas internacionais de contabilidade (IFRS e CPC's).
  • Análise de balanços.
  • Conhecimento em Power BI.
  • Automação de processos contábeis.

Disponibilidade para Horário comercial.

Local de Trabalho: Porto Velho/RO - Rua da Beira 6671, Bairro Lagoa.

  • 7+ years of experience in DevOps, with 5+ years in Azure environments
  • Expertise in Azure infrastructure, networking, and security, including VNets, Front Door, WAF, Firewalls (Premium + IDPS), VPN, DNS, AD, App Service, Container Apps, Function Apps, Event Hub, Defender, and Sentinel
  • Preferred experience administering Azure AD B2C, with deep understanding of identity and authentication security best practices
  • Strong experience with Terraform (IaC), managing scalable and resilient cloud infrastructure.

  • Proficiency in Git and GitHub for version control and workflow automation
  • Experience in optimizing cloud costs (FinOps) and monitoring usage trends.

  • Manage and optimize Azure infrastructure, networking, security, and identity management, ensuring compliance with SOC 2 and industry best practices
  • Ensure customer-facing systems maintain high availability and rapid incident response, including automated failover and disaster recovery strategies
  • Maintain and enhance Azure Pipelines for seamless CI/CD workflows, integrating automated security, unit, integration, and end-to-end testing
  • Implement and manage Terraform for infrastructure automation
  • Own the Datadog APM ecosystem, implementing best practices for monitoring, logging, and alerting to ensure system health and compliance
  • Implement DevSecOps practices, including security scanning, role-based access controls (RBAC), and proactive threat mitigation using Azure Defender and Sentinel
  • Continuously monitor Azure cost trends, implementing FinOps strategies to optimize cloud expenses while maintaining performance and security
  • Administer and enhance Azure AD B2C, ensuring secure authentication and identity management
  • Develop and maintain incident response playbooks and disaster recovery strategies, ensuring data integrity and business continuity
  • Work closely with Engineering and Security teams, documenting best practices, infrastructure changes, and operational procedures

  • Generous paid-time-off policy

  • Work remotely
  • Continuing education, training, conferences
  • Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

Distribuída em mais de 40 países, líder mundial em processamento de oleaginosas e uma das maiores produtoras e fornecedoras de óleos, gorduras e proteínas vegetais há mais de dois séculos, a Bunge trabalha com o propósito de conectar agricultores a consumidores para fornecer alimentos, ingredientes e combustíveis essenciais para o mundo. Há 117 anos no Brasil, contamos com mais de 100 unidades e somos uma das principais empresas de agronegócio e alimentos, líder em originação de grãos e em processamento de soja e trigo. Em todas as nossas cadeias de valor promovemos nossos negócios de maneira sustentável ao mesmo tempo que apoiamos o bem-estar social e econômico das comunidades onde atuamos. Valorizamos a diversidade de nossos times e buscamos talentos criativos com espírito de equipe e vontade de fazer a diferença. Em tudo o que fazemos, colocamos em prática nossos valores:

  1. Atuar como um só time, promovendo a inclusão, a colaboração e o respeito;
  2. Buscar a excelência, sendo ágeis, inovadores e eficientes;
  3. Fazer o que é certo, agindo de forma segura, ética e sustentável.

Na Bunge, valorizamos a diversidade em todas as suas formas e trabalhamos em prol de uma cultura inclusiva e de pertencimento, com respeito e equidade. Aqui, todas as pessoas são bem-vindas como são!

Nossa empresa possui uma sólida trajetória e estamos construindo um futuro repleto de oportunidades! Faça parte de nosso time e venha trilhar sua jornada profissional com a gente.

A Auditoria Interna Global é uma função 100% rotativa e considerada uma fonte essencial de talentos para o negócio. O combustível para este motor 100% rotativo é o nosso Programa de Desenvolvimento da Auditoria Interna Global, que oferece a oportunidade de rotatividade para dentro e fora da área de negócios.

Fazer parte da equipe de Auditoria Interna Global permitirá que você:

  1. Gere um retorno tangível para o negócio, participando efetivamente de uma variedade de projetos baseados em riscos e solicitados pela gestão.
  2. Transforme a função, fortalecendo sua marca, por meio de sua participação em iniciativas do departamento destinadas a desenvolver talentos, aprimorar nossos serviços e construir relacionamentos produtivos com as partes interessadas.
  3. Invista fortemente em seu desenvolvimento, participando ativamente do Programa de Desenvolvimento da Auditoria Interna Global.
  4. Participe de outras atividades estratégicas de negócios, conforme solicitado pela gestão.

O Auditor se reportará diretamente aos Diretores de Auditoria Interna Global e aos Gerentes/Gerentes Sênior de Auditoria Interna Global. Esta função exige uma combinação de habilidades de pensamento crítico e um forte entendimento de processos de negócios e princípios de gestão de riscos.

  9. Capacidade de estabelecer e manter relacionamentos de trabalho harmoniosos com colegas de trabalho, contatos internos e externos, e trabalhar efetivamente em um ambiente de equipe profissional.
  10. Capacidade de trabalhar em um ambiente global em constante crescimento, com viagens de aproximadamente 20%.

Somos o Grupo Hortifruti Natural da Terra, a maior rede varejista de hortifrutigranjeiros do Brasil.

title: SAP - Profitability Analisys
description:
A leading global provider of products and services to the energy industry, embarked on a multi-year transformation journey to streamline,

standardize, and digitalize operations by fully implementing a Global ERP System (S/4HANA).

The Key business goals include strengthening data governance, enhancing platform standardization through a “Clean Core” approach, process optimization

and tax and statutory compliance for each location, with an ongoing focus on rapid response to commercial and operational needs.

To meet these goals, workshop sessions must be addressed for each key workstream to make key design decisions in the following areas:

• Financial Statements design and mapping

• Statutory and tax configuration needs

• Data migration/conversion

• Fixed asset tax booking

• E-Document/e-Invoice + DRC (fit to standard analysis and decision on WRICEF needed)

• TRM (Treasury & Risk Management

This transformation journey began with the a value architecting phase, and currently, the implementation phase is undergoing:

The implementation is split into separate releases for deploying SAP S/4HANA in different locations, covering critical processes such as Order-to-Cash (OTC),

Procure-to-Pay (P2P), Hire-to-Retire (H2R), and Enterprise Asset Management (EAM).

The RTR Team Member for SAP Profitability Analysis and Controlling supports the global finance function by managing and optimizing processes related to product costing,cost center accounting, and profitability analysis (CO-PA) in SAP S/4HANA. The role ensures accurate reporting and control of financial data, enabling strategic decision-making and regulatory compliance.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Support the Record-to-Report (RTR) process with a focus on Controlling (CO) and Profitability Analysis (CO-PA) .

  • Configure and maintain cost element accounting , cost center accounting , internal orders , and profit centers in SAP.

  • Set up and support account-based and costing-based CO-PA structures, value fields, and characteristics.

  • UAT support for performing variance analysis, actual vs. planned cost comparisons, and profitability reporting.

  • Monitor and support month-end close activities for CO modules including assessments, distributions, settlements , and allocations .

  • Analyze and resolve system or process issues in collaboration with clients' IT and business stakeholders.

  • Provide input into design of enhancements and process improvements.

  • Document configurations, business processes, and training materials.

  • Ensure compliance with internal controls, policies, and external regulatory requirements.

  • Participate in finance transformation or ERP rollout projects as a subject matter expert for SAP CO and CO-PA.

Required Skills & Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or related field.

  • 8+ years of hands-on experience in SAP Controlling (CO) and CO-PA modules (S/4HANA experience preferred).

  • Deep understanding of product costing , cost center planning , profitability reporting , and cost allocations .

  • Experience with financial reporting , variance analysis , and month-end close activities .

  • Strong knowledge of integration points between SAP CO, FI, MM, and SD modules.

  • Ability to interpret financial results and explain profitability drivers.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in a shared services or global business services environment.

  • Experience in profitability analysis for energy, manufacturing or utilities industry .

  • Familiarity with SAP BPC, SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) , or Group Reporting is a plus.

  • Professional certifications such as CMA, CPA , or SAP CO certification .

description:

  2. Desejável formação em Engenharia Mecânica ou Elétrica

Atribuições do Cargo

  1. Realizar levantamento de dados técnicos para especificação completa de materiais e componentes eletromecânicos industriais e de equipamentos de mina para as unidades de cimento, concreto e agregados.
  2. Realizar, se necessário, consulta técnica de especificação de materiais junto a fornecedores, arquivos técnicos das unidades, equipe de manutenção, etc.
  3. Verificar catálogos, relatórios técnicos, books, desenhos técnicos dos equipamentos e/ou de projetos das unidades bem como carregá-los no sistema SAP – DMS.
  4. Realizar solicitações para cadastros, modificações, ampliações e/ou manutenção de materiais via sistema SAP PM e MM, caso não identificada similaridade no grupo.
  5. Realizar o controle das solicitações de cadastros, modificações, ampliações e/ou manutenção dos materiais existentes no sistema SAP ambiente CADMAT.
  6. Realizar leitura e interpretação de catálogos e desenhos técnicos para abertura de processos de cadastros.
  7. Realizar reuniões de esclarecimento de dados técnicos junto as equipes de Engenharia de Manutenção e/ou PCM - Planejamento e Controle de Manutenção das unidades.
  8. Participar da elaboração de relatórios técnicos gerenciais para controle de produtividade e avanço físico das entregas dos cadastros, modificações, ampliações ou manutenção dos materiais.
  9. Dar as devidas tratativas nos casos de devoluções de processo de cadastros, respondendo e/ou esclarecendo dúvidas técnicas, inserindo catálogos, relatórios técnicos, books, desenhos, projetos e/ou outras informações técnicas complementares.
  10. Garantir informações técnicas fidedignas aos projetos eletromecânicos das unidades e responsabilizar-se pela correta especificação técnica garantindo assertividade nas aquisições, de compras ou de reparos, necessárias ao processo de manutenção das unidades.
  11. Garantir que todos os controles do processo de cadastro estejam corretamente preenchidos nas pastas compartilhadas na rede intranet da CSN.
  12. Entender e cumprir com a Política, Regras e Padrões de Saúde e Segurança (S&S) da CSN Cimentos, mantendo uma cultura sólida de S&S através do senso de dono; da zero tolerância à desvios de saúde e segurança; da execução de ações preventivas e corretivas para atendimento das metas e controle dos riscos ambientais e de incidentes; e da participação nos treinamentos necessários para estar apto a trabalhar de forma segura.
  13. Zelar pela sua própria saúde e segurança e dos demais, interrompendo atividades inseguras, garantindo a aplicação da hierarquia de controle de riscos, realizando o direito de recusa, o cumprimento da política de reconhecimento e consequências e o conhecimento do plano de atendimento emergencial (PAE) da unidade onde estiver atuando.
  14. Aplicar as ferramentas e processos de gerenciamento de riscos e gestão de mudanças, conhecer os riscos associados às atividades e executá-las de forma segura.
  15. Comunicar todos os incidentes.

Somos um dos mais eficientes complexos siderúrgicos integrados do mundo, atuando com destaque em cinco setores: Siderurgia, Mineração, Logística, Cimento e Energia.

A CSN Cimentos é uma das principais empresas do setor de materiais de construção, com foco em cimento, concreto e agregados. Seus produtos e soluções inovadoras são utilizados em diferentes projetos de construção, desde moradias até obras desafiadoras de infraestrutura. A empresa tem uma gestão focada no desenvolvimento de suas equipes e na convivência harmônica com as comunidades nas cidades onde opera.

Com cerca de 3.000 colaboradores a empresa possui um parque industrial distribuído no Sudeste, Nordeste e Centro-Oeste, com mais de 35 unidades no Brasil. Temos o compromisso de seguir todas as normas e recomendações do Pacto Global de ESG. Nosso foco é aumentar a diversidade, incentivando a inclusão, igualdade, respeito e tolerância às diferenças. A CSN Cimentos é signatária dos Princípios de Empoderamento das Mulheres da ONU e no tema de mulheres na liderança é referência na indústria da construção.

Buscamos atrair e desenvolver profissionais que se identifiquem com a nossa cultura. É certificada como uma das melhores empresas para se trabalhar na Indústria pelo GTPW.

Venha fazer parte da nossa essência: “fazer bem, fazer mais e fazer para sempre

title: Engineering Manager, Device Intelligence - Brazil
description:
About the Team

The Identity Intelligence team's mission is to eliminate threats and empower the growth of the DoorDash business by providing the source of truth for User Identity and the relationships of connected identifiers. We provide protection across DoorDash's external-facing endpoints. We are making dedicated investments into this space to drive major business impact for teams across DoorDash.

Our team is foundational and sits at the intersection of many other teams, serving critical needs related to user identification, attestation, and device intelligence. We envision our systems to be highly reliable, providing the source of truth for identity-related data with high quality, invaluable, and accurate information. This empowers teams to make the best business decisions, whether solving for fraud or unlocking growth.

We are focused on building extensible platforms, enabling teams to easily and quickly leverage the systems to build critical features. Improving engineering velocity with self-serve tooling and seamless end-to-end integrations that can deliver data insights from the client to the backend system is a key priority.

Our domain currently includes:

  • Identity Graph: Providing the source of truth for User Identities and relationships between all entities.
  • Attestation: Ensuring all requests to DoorDash servers are legitimate, including protection against bot traffic.
  • Device: Uniquely and accurately identifying physical devices that access DoorDash and providing device-related insights.

About the Role

As the Engineering Manager, Identity Intelligence, you will oversee a talented group of engineers, collaborating closely with designers, product managers, operations, and other cross-functional partners. Your primary responsibility will be driving the successful execution of our product roadmap, ensuring the timely delivery of high-quality solutions that meet both customer needs and business objectives. You will be key in fostering a collaborative and cross-functional work environment and promoting effective communication and synergy amongst team members. This role is ideal for a strategic thinker with strong leadership skills who can balance technical excellence with business priorities, especially in the critical domain of identity and security. You will report into Arjun Mukhopadhyay ( ).

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Lead and grow a team of exceptional engineers, empowering through delegation, and delivering end-to-end engineering solutions for Identity Intelligence systems.
  • Collaborate with Product Managers, Business leaders, and key stakeholders to determine the team's roadmap and vision, and manage execution against that roadmap, focusing on the strategic technical vision for Identity Graph, Attestation, and Device Intelligence.
  • Provide architectural guidance and professional development for a team of 5+, particularly in the context of building reliable, scalable, and extensible platforms for identity data.
  • Encourage innovation, teamwork, implementation of cutting-edge technologies (including ML-based solutions), and outside-of-the-box thinking to address complex identity and security challenges.
  • Oversee the hiring process for your team, in partnership with recruiting, to grow a diverse and inclusive team with expertise in areas like distributed systems, data engineering, and security.

We're excited about you because you have…

  • BS, M.S., or PhD. in Computer Science or related field.
  • 2+ years of experience in people management leading backend teams of 5+ engineers including a staff engineer.
  • 7+ years of industry experience.
  • Experience working with remote teams in different time zone(s) and fluency in English.
  • Extensive experience as an engineer in a fast-paced, product-focused development environment.
  • Experience with distributed system design, system scaling, and performance optimization, especially in the context of data-intensive and security-critical systems.
  • Hands-on leadership and strong product intuition, with a keen understanding of identity and security concerns.
  • Humility - willing to get into the details and open to feedback.
  • Growth mindset - you're eager to expand your skill set and excited to carve out your career path in a hyper-growth setting.
  • Adaptability, resiliency, and ability to thrive in ambiguity - things can change quickly, and you'll need to help the team evolve.
  • Familiarity with concepts related to Identity Graph, Attestation, and Device Intelligence
  • Understanding of data quality, monitoring, and analytics in the context of identity data.
  • Interest in exploring and implementing ML-based solutions for identity and security challenges.

A Joalheria que Transforma Histórias em Joias!
Com sede em Copenhague, Dinamarca, a Pandora fabrica suas deslumbrantes joias em três instalações de artesanato na Tailândia, onde mestres artesãos dedicam-se a criar cada peça com perfeição, se destacando como a maior joalheria do mundo, famosa por seus icônicos braceletes e charms que permitem que você conte sua própria história. Somos todos embaixadores de nossa marca e, juntos, formamos a comunidade Pandora.

• Forte visão de negócios com a capacidade de analisar relatórios de vendas com segurança, indicadores comerciais e falar sobre os negócios da loja;

title: Senior Manager, Technical Recruiting - Brazil
description:
About the Team

The DoorDash Recruiting Team is focused on building DoorDash culture, one quality hire at a time. We partner with hiring teams to execute recruiting strategies that help DoorDash to hire qualified candidates in the most efficient and unbiased ways.

We're looking for a Sr. Manager of Technical Recruiting to oversee our hiring efforts as we build out our São Paulo, Brazil location. DoorDash is growing and scaling at an unprecedented rate, and you will play a critical role in helping shape the technical recruiting function as we build to fully realize DoorDash’s dream: to grow and empower local economies. We’re focused on improvement — from moving faster to leveling up the quality of our product — and our work is never complete. If you’re looking to define your career as part of something greater than yourself, come scale with us.

Joining DoorDash means working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where your ideas can shape products, impact millions of users, and help merchants, Dashers, and customers thrive. We value creativity, ownership, and continuous learning — and we’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone can grow their careers while making a real difference.

We also care deeply about our team’s well-being. DoorDash offers comprehensive benefits, including premium healthcare, paid parental leave, wellness reimbursements, and more — because we believe that when our people thrive, our communities thrive too.

About the Role

The Sr. Manager, Technical Recruiting - Brazil will be responsible for developing and driving our recruiting strategy at scale. You will lead the hiring strategy and execution across our technical hiring teams investing in Brazil, and report directly to the Sr. Director, Technical Recruiting in our People organization.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will...

  • Lead DoorDash’s technical recruiting strategy in São Paulo with a focus on acquiring top diverse talent to meet our current and future hiring needs.
  • Attract, develop, and retain recruiters of all levels and capabilities, with a focus on industry knowledge and innovation.
  • Deploy forecasting, reporting, and analytics rigor to track key recruiting metrics and measure progress against team OKRs (objectives and key results).
    • Deliver ongoing reports to track results, impact, hiring quality, and cost-effectiveness of the recruiting team.
    • Use information to detect trends/insights and adjust the strategy to optimize the impact of the team.
    • Proactively communicate strategy updates and team productivity to recruiting leadership and hiring teams.
  • Provide expert guidance to our leaders and hiring managers to attract, select, onboard, and retain highly-skilled candidates.
  • Contribute to the design, implementation, and maintenance of processes, tools, and systems needed to scale and support the recruiting team in both the short and long term.
  • Focus on building out proactive hiring strategies supporting org design, succession planning, and always-on talent pipeline.
  • Develop employment brand opportunities and partner with our cross-functional teams to create one-to-many strategic talent engagements with prospective talent pools.

We’re excited about you because…

  • You have at least 10 years of recruiting or equivalent business experience, with at least 5 years of experience leading and managing high-performing teams within a hyper-growth environment at progressive companies.
  • You are proficient in both English and Portuguese.
  • You are an authentic, inspiring and hands-on leader with experience driving, building and scaling recruiting teams in hyper-growth environments.
  • You are a beacon for the best recruiters — they seek you out and will follow you anywhere.
  • You build trusted relationships with people at all levels, across multiple functions and in all geographies.
  • You have a bias for action and have an inner drive and fierce commitment to excel in the pursuit of business goals.
  • You possess a penchant for seeking out new experiences, knowledge, and candid feedback and an openness to learning and change.
  • You have the courage to take on difficult goals and bounce back from adversity in the face of challenges.
  • You have an understanding of technology and/or logistics industries and extensive experience leading in-house, geographically dispersed recruiting teams.
  • You're skilled at using data and analytics to develop insights and drive decisions.
  • You have a strong point of view on how diversity and inclusion play a key role in a company’s success, track record of leading teams to achieve diversity recruiting goals, and proven success working with internal and external diversity partners.
  • You have adaptable and superior communication skills (verbal, written, and presentation) at all levels (individual contributor to executive level).

About DoorDash

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started with door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known for delivering food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees’ happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

title: Actuarial Pensions Consultant – All Levels Welcome
description:
Description

We welcome applications from candidates at all stages of their actuarial journey—whether you're part-qualified, nearly or newly qualified, or fully qualified.

Your role at WTW

You will be joining WTW as a Pension Actuarial Consultant, contributing to our UK Defined Benefit pensions work. We welcome applications from part-qualified, recently qualified, and fully qualified actuaries with relevant experience in core UK pensions actuarial work.

We work with a wide range of clients and your work may cover both trustee and corporate assignments.As well as providing advice on regular valuations, accounting, PPF levies, individual calculations, and factor reviews, we often work alongside our clients on innovative, market-leading projects.

As a pension actuarial consultant at WTW, you will have opportunities to contribute to varied and interesting projects such as:

  • Integrated risk management
  • Liability management
  • Guaranteed minimum pension (GMP) equalisation
  • Plan design strategy
  • Asset and liability modelling and journey planning strategy
  • Mergers and acquisitions

You will be part of a collaborative and inclusive team environment, actively engaging in team collaboration and building relationships.

As a pension actuarial consultant, you will also mentor junior colleagues, developing their skills, while demonstrating strong project management and delegation skills.

See more information about our WTW careers page:

Qualifications

Required Skills and Experience

  • Experience working as a pension actuary on core UK defined benefit pensions actuarial work.
  • IFoA part-qualified, nearly/newly qualified OR qualified actuary - All levels welcome.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills to deliver impactful client interactions.
  • Proven delegation skills and a desire to coach and mentor junior colleagues.
  • Sense of accountability: owning your work and taking pride in it.
  • Self-starter: interest in continually challenging yourself and willingness to step outside of your comfort zone.
  • Ability to think beyond the task at hand and understand how work fits into the broader landscape.

Desired Skills and Experience

  • Experience working as a part-qualified actuary on core UK defined benefit actuarial work.
  • IFoApart-qualifiedactuary (or equivalent).
  • Strong client-service orientation.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring an Engineering Manager for Ceph & Distributed Storage. The world creates more than 2.5 quintillion bytes of data every day! We want to help teams to store data in open source storage on commodity hardware - safely, cheaply and simply.
Our goal is to make Ceph easy to install, manage and use - from large enterprise data center installations to half-rack edge sites. We believe that distributed storage shouldn't be hard - and to keep up with the increasing data storage demands, it needs to be easier than ever before. We have a range of tools to bring to bear on the problem, and we're excited to make distributed Ceph easy enough that everyone does it.
As an engineering manager at Canonical you must be technically strong, but your responsibility is to run an effective team and develop the colleagues you manage. You are expected to help them grow as engineers, do important work, do it outstandingly well, find professional and personal satisfaction, and work well with colleagues and community. Technical leadership experience and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to lead, challenge, and develop strong engineers, positively influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution. You will be responsible for sound software architecture and best practices in software quality, testing and documentation.
What you'll do

  • You will lead a team building a Ceph focused software defined storage solution
  • You will build and manage a globally distributed team of engineers
  • You'll develop your team through coaching, mentoring and feedback
  • You will demonstrate sound engineering principles by directly contributing toward your team's goals
  • Set reasonable schedules based on considered estimates, with feedback loops for improvement
  • Set and manage expectations with other engineering teams and external stakeholders
  • Advance modern, agile software development practices
  • Maintain a culture of quality and engineering excellence
  • Grow a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company values
  • Be an active part of the leadership team and collaborate with other leaders in the organisation
  • Work from home with global travel up to 20% for internal and external events
Who you are
  • You have a software engineering background, preferably with Python and C++ experience
  • You have experience operating scale out storage clusters on Linux in production environments, preferably with Ceph
  • You love embracing new technologies and pushing the boundaries of what is possibleYou love developing and growing people and have a track record of doing it
  • You have an interest in building products that improve how people operate software and infrastructure everywhere
  • You are knowledgeable and passionate about software development
  • You have experience in leading, managing, coaching and mentoring software developers towards delivering timely, high quality software together
  • You have solid experience working in an agile development environment
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Regional Director, LATAM São Paulo, Brazil
description:
Interested in working on cutting-edge blockchain technology and creating equitable access to the global financial system? Since 2014, the mission-driven team at the Stellar Development Foundation (SDF) has helped fuel the tremendous growth of the Stellar blockchain network, an open-source platform that operates at high-scale today. Developers and companies around the world build on it, and the SDF team is expanding to support the rapidly growing and changing Stellar ecosystem.

We are looking for a seasoned Regional Director to help drive business development efforts across LATAM for SDF. The person in this role will serve as a key regional public-facing voice and thought leader helping to educate and inform the region about the Stellar ecosystem. This person will further create organizational efficiency by assisting with coordination of all SDF activity in that area - from business development focused on developers up through large regional financial institutions, to event representation and planning, to policy and regulatory initiatives. They will support the broader partnership team and company objectives, and will be close partners and shared owners of all primary OKRs.

In this role, your responsibilities will include:

  • Business development work related to our core priorities on expanding DeFi, increasing monthly addresses, and driving asset tokenization, in coordination with Leads of each partnership vertical to drive relevant outcomes. These include surfacing opportunities based on SDF's needs, as well as helping to close deals brought by other members of BD and SDF.
  • Assisting on regulatory and government relations needs in region, helping support the Legal, Policy and Government Relations teams.
  • Assisting the Ecosystem team to identify, plan, and run events in region.

You have:

  • 10+ years of relevant experience with a proven track record of success in business development roles within the blockchain, fintech, or financial services industries.
  • A minimum of 2 years of experience in the blockchain industry, either at a blockchain company or in a role working on blockchain technology and use cases.
  • Strong understanding of the cryptocurrency landscape and experience working with crypto exchanges, custodians, and asset tokenization platforms.
  • A high degree of accountability with STRONG ability to communicate regional progress and all outcomes at frequent intervals to stakeholders.
  • Ability to work in a collaborative team environment, with multiple stakeholders, while often working remotely from said team.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, with the ability to develop and maintain professional relationships with a network of senior-level professionals, as well as sound judgment, poise in professional settings, and self-awareness.
  • Self-starter with an entrepreneurial drive.
  • The ability to travel as needed, with frequent representation of Stellar at regional meetings and conferences.

Bonus points if you have:

  • Existing relationships within the crypto ecosystem, particularly with a focus on tokenization and decentralized finance.
  • Existing relationships with financial institutions, particularly on the asset management side.

We offer competitive pay for this position depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. In addition, we offer lumen-denominated grants along with other perks and benefits.

We look forward to hearing from you!

About the Stellar Development Foundation

The Stellar Development Foundation (SDF) is a non-profit organization focused on working with and supporting changemakers to create equitable access to the global financial system through blockchain technology. SDF provides grants, investments, funding, and other awards to builders and organizations. SDF also develops resources and tooling on the Stellar network to help unlock real-world utility. As a nonprofit foundation, SDF puts the health of the Stellar network and the Stellar ecosystem and its mission above all else.

SDF is committed to diversity in its workforce and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. SDF does not make hiring or employment decisions on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, sex, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, citizenship, or any other basis protected by applicable local, state or federal law.

The Learning and Development (L&D) plays a critical role in fostering employee growth, improving performance, and supporting organizational goals. It involves identifying skill gaps, designing and delivering training programs, and creating opportunities for continuous learning. L&D empowers employees to reach their full potential while helping the organization stay agile, competitive, and future-ready.

Role Responsibilities

  • The Learning & Development Manager is responsible for designing and implementing strategies to enhance employee growth, leadership development, and organizational capability.
  • This role involves assessing business needs, identifying skill gaps, and developing targeted learning programs that drive performance and career progression.
  • Lead the creation of comprehensive training frameworks, including leadership development, functional upskilling, and soft skills enhancement.
  • Additionally, they will collaborate with business leaders and HR partners to build a strong learning culture, leveraging data-driven insights to measure training effectiveness and continuously refine development initiatives.
  • This role requires a proactive approach to talent planning, coaching, and fostering an environment where employees are empowered to reach their full potential.

Role Qualifications

  • The Talent Development Expert requires a strong mix of strategic thinking, instructional design, and leadership development expertise.
  • 4-6 years of experience.
  • The ideal candidate should have deep knowledge of learning methodologies, adult learning principles, and training program design to create impactful development initiatives.
  • Strong analytical and data-driven decision-making skills are essential to assess training effectiveness and optimize programs.
  • Additionally, the role demands excellent stakeholder management and communication skills to collaborate with leaders, HR partners, and employees at all levels.
  • Expertise in coaching, facilitation, and change management is crucial to drive a continuous learning culture.
  • Adaptability, creativity, and a proactive approach to talent development will be key to success in this role.

  • We create customer value – We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant, and efficient.

  • We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.
  • We believe in Diversity and Inclusion – Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what makes us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

Diversity & Inclusion

Diversity is not a future vision or a wish for something we want someday; it is a non-negotiable value of who we are today.

We embrace inclusion, plurality, and respect, and to achieve this, we rely on the governance of the Diversity Committee, which works alongside HR, our leadership, and identity groups—99Adapta, 99Afro, 99Colors, 99Women, and 99Families.

This challenging role demands a high degree of technical skill with low-level operating systems, kernel, and device firmware.

    • Bootloaders in ARM and X86, such as piboot, uboot, grub-uefi
    • Systemd and units, udev, initrd, graphics
    • OS level firmware daemons and CLI applications
    • Linux security implementations - TPM, FDE, LUKS, HSM, etc.

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. title: Senior Data Quality & Governance Engineer
description:
Bold Metrics is the leading fit and sizing solution on the market today for the world’s top retailers and brands. We are a venture-backed startup that is making a big impact on the environment, forever changing the landscape of eCommerce. We are a remote-first company that is full of inspiring and friendly people.

We are currently searching for a Senior Data Quality Engineer to join our fast-growing team. This position is for someone located in São Paulo, Brazil who is able to come into the office in-person at least once weekly. In this position, you will have the opportunity to work with some of our biggest projects within the retail industry.

About You:

You are a humble, passionate, and experienced engineer that is looking for a collaborative and analytical Data Quality Engineering role to support the execution of our product deliveries and client reporting services. This comprises validating the data flow as a whole, from data sources to data consumers, including BI dashboards and ML models.

As our Senior Data Quality Engineer, you are an extremely detail-oriented, out-of-the-box problem solver with a commitment to doing high-quality work. You will work with the Engineering, Product, and Customer Success teams to support the flow of cleaned, quality data to ultimately drive customer success.

How You Will Make an Impact:

  • Lead the data quality engineering team and efforts across the organization
  • Identify metrics used to measure data quality
  • Establish data validations that cover both functional and domain-specific KPI data
  • Monitor data quality metrics and perform root cause analysis of data quality issues, taking appropriate steps to address any issues
  • Make sure that data quality processes are integrated into the data architecture
  • Support all the data governance initiatives
  • Understand the data and KPI reporting requirements for clients, ensuring that the data quality initiatives align

Skills and Qualifications: (even if you do not meet these skills 100%, we still welcome you to apply)

  • BSc or MSc in Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science, or related field
  • 6+ years’ experience in data engineering and quality assessment roles
  • High level of proficiency with Python and SQL
  • Some experience with DBT would be a bonus
  • A strong understanding of data management concepts including data profiling and mapping
  • Skilled in performing data quality assessments to identify data inconsistencies, inaccuracies, and incompleteness in data products
  • Strong analytical skills to identify patterns and trends in data and data quality issues
  • Good understanding of data governance concepts including data privacy and security
  • A mindset of continuous improvement, identifying areas for improvement within the data quality process and workflows
  • Ability to troubleshoot and solve data quality issues, including identifying the root cause of problems and implementing effective solutions
  • Above-bar communication skills, both written and oral, to interface in a collaborative team environment
  • Well-organized individual that pays close attention to detail
  • Able to effectively prioritize in a fast-paced and fast-changing environment
  • Bonus if you have experience integrating with large retail e-commerce sites

About Us:

Bold Metrics, established in 2017, is a SaaS solution for retailers and brands to reduce returns, improve sustainability and supercharge their supply chain from the ground up. Using a comprehensive set of machine learning and AI technologies to accurately capture customer body measurements, we help apparel brands unlock the power of body data to meet the demands of today's increasingly personalized world.

Learn more about us at boldmetrics.com

We strive to create a place to work where we all feel safe, empowered, engaged, and inspired. Position Summary
Bentley Systems is seeking a talented individual to become a valued member of the Product Support team as a Technical Support Engineer. As part of the Global Technical Support team, the technical support engineer is responsible for providing technical assistance on the product via (inbound/outbound) phone, e-mail, and web portal. This is a hands-on position that will interface with our users as well as our development, professional services, and sales departments. The position is responsible for problem analysis, documentation, resolution, and escalation involving Bentley’s supported products
We Will Rely On You For The Following

  • Provide troubleshooting and technical assistance for ProjectWise Product functionality/features to users via e-mail, service tickets, phone, and web-portal (BE Communities.
  • Assist with all facets of Bentley users and technical support by helping to identify user issues by isolating and resolving the issue or by proper escalation.
  • Advise and educate users on accurate usage of the Product and address specific use cases reported on the Service Requests.
  • Work in a fast-paced environment while collaborating with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Act as a liaison between users and Product Management/Development.
  • Research and identify solutions to ProjectWise Product functionality/features.
  • Ask users targeted questions to quickly understand the root of the problem.
  • Maintain accurate notes and details on user support requests.
  • Properly escalate unresolved issues to appropriate internal teams (e.g., software developers).
  • Communicate with team members regarding current/ongoing issues via daily scrum calls.
  • Document software problem defects for review and take corrective actions.
  • Document technical knowledge in the form of Knowledgebase Articles or Communities Posts.
  • Meet with internal Bentley teams to provide the users’ perspective on our products and services.

Your Daily Tasks Will Look Like This
  • Review individual Support Case Backlog and prioritize Aged and Escalated Requests.
  • Reproduce issues in-house on test systems (Virtual Machines) to isolate the cause of the problem.
  • Monitor the Team Support Cases Queue and pick issues in the order of priority, impact, and age of the Service Request.
  • Update and follow-up with users over the phone/email on existing Requests.
  • Engage on Team Scrum calls to discuss issues and liaison with the team
  • Adhere to Phone Queue Schedule and ensure phones are always manned and voicemails processed.
  • Contribute to Bentley Communities and answer user queries.
  • Update the Team Technical Knowledge Base and share updates with the team.
  • Upskill on Product Knowledge by focusing on a new topic every week. Consume Training through internal Pathways, Wikis, videos, etc.
  • Channelize potential Defects/Enhancements to the Product Management/Development teams.
  • Provide a handover to the next shift with appropriate documentation when needed

What You Bring To The Team
  • 2+ years of experience in technical support and exposure to global user interaction.
  • Bachelor’s degree in IT, Engineering, or related fields.
  • Experience or Knowledge with ProjectWise product suites or similar document management systems such as Documentum, Vault or Aconex.
  • Experience with the Administration of Engineering Information/Document Management systems.
  • Experience or knowledge with relational databases: Microsoft SQL Server or Oracle.
  • Experience or knowledge with Networking (DNS, TCP\IP, FQDN, cluster environments).
  • Experience or knowledge with Windows Operating System (Server and client) for administration and debugging.
  • A "user first" approach and strong critical thinking, with a desire to solve problems with excellent troubleshooting skills.
  • Emotional intelligence when talking with users, and the ability to document methodically.
  • Exposure to answering queries via Service Requests and Communities forum posts.
  • Ability to work well with Global colleagues to help address user issues.
  • Ability to manage time effectively by delegating, prioritizing, and scheduling tasks to ensure they are completed in the expected timelines.
  • A motivated self-starter with the ability to work independently and in a team.

What Would Make You Stand Out
  • Experience with ProjectWise infrastructure.
  • Knowledge or experience of IIS (Internet Information Services),
  • Proven success in all aspects of ProjectWise Administration.
  • Experience with MicroStation, AutoCAD, Revit, Civil 3D, IPLOT (Printing\Plotting).
  • Knowledge with extended ProjectWise features (Publishing such as ICS for PDF, BAS; Bentley cloud features such as Deliverables Management, ProjectWise Drive, ProjectWise Projects, WSG, etc.)

Summary

Administers all forms of respiratory care, both critical and general therapy, and directs and manages the respiratory and pulmonary care for a designated group of patients. Provides respiratory assessment, support, treatment, and diagnostic tests as part of the healthcare team.

Job Duties
  • Conducts evaluation, management and care of patients with deficiencies and abnormalities of the cardiopulmonary system.
  • Performs inventory of respiratory equipment and maintains adequate stock of equipment.
  • Provides respiratory therapy to patients as ordered by physicians according to established standards and practices.
  • Trains other staff including physicians and students in issues relevant to respiratory therapy.
  • Performs mechanical ventilator management, Bi-pap, and respiratory monitoring.
  • Performs emergency cardiopulmonary resuscitation and maintains adequate airways, measures ventilator volumes, pressures, and flows of patients requiring critical care.
  • Performs arterial blood gas studies as well as pulse oximetry, interpretation, and analysis.
  • Educates patients in collaboration in various clinical situations such as sleep apnea and CPAP machines, proper fitting of mask and headgear, and setting of pressures in concordance to sleep studio requirements.
  • Sets-up diagnostic nocturnal sleep screens.
  • Sets up, checks equipment, and administers respiratory medication for aerosol treatment as ordered by the physicians/or by patient-driven protocols, charts treatment, response, and progress.
Minimum Qualifications
  • Associate’s Degree Graduate from an RRT program accredited by the commission of accreditation for Respiratory Care.
  • Less than 1 year.
  • Ability to provide respiratory therapy methodologies and techniques.
  • Ability to operate and trouble-shoot diagnostic equipment.
  • RRT - Registered Respiratory Therapist NBRC - State of Pennsylvania within 1 Year.
  • ACLS - Advanced Cardiovascular Life Support - State of Pennsylvania within 60 Days.
  • American Heart Association Basic Life Support - State of Pennsylvania within 30 Days.
  • PALS - Pediatric Advanced Life Support - State of Pennsylvania within 60 Days.
  • NRP - Neonatal Resuscitation Program - State of Pennsylvania within 60 Days.
  • RCP - Respiratory Care Practitioner - State of Pennsylvania Upon Hire.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s Degree Graduate from an RRT program accredited by the commission of accreditation for Respiratory Care.
Physical Demands

Lift and carry 40-50 lbs. Examples: Push/pull patients on bed, stretcher (requires 29 lbs. push force), lateral transfers up to 50 lbs. of the patient's weight. Frequent to continuous standing/walking. Patient transporters can walk 8-10 miles per shift. *Patient care providers may be required to perform activities specific to their role including kneeling, bending, squatting and performing CPR.
